entries.name: split_at
entries.statement:
∀ (l : List[A]) (k : Num)
if
  1. k < LENGTH(l)
then
  ∃ (vi vs : List[A]),
    LENGTH(vi) == k
    && l == APPEND(vi, CONS(EL(k, l), vs))

entries.name: el_split
entries.statement: ∀ (vi vs : List[A]) (v : A), EL(LENGTH(vi), APPEND(vi, CONS(v, vs))) == v

entries.name: list_update_split
entries.statement:
∀ (vi vs : List[A]) (v x : A),
  list_update(APPEND(vi, CONS(v, vs)), LENGTH(vi), x) == APPEND(vi, CONS(x, vs))

entries.name: el_at
entries.statement:
∀ (l vi vs : List[A]) (v : A) (k : Num)
if
  1. l == APPEND(vi, CONS(v, vs))
  2. LENGTH(vi) == k
then
  EL(k, l) == v

entries.name: update_at
entries.statement:
∀ (l vi vs : List[A]) (v x : A) (k : Num)
if
  1. l == APPEND(vi, CONS(v, vs))
  2. LENGTH(vi) == k
then
  list_update(l, k, x) == APPEND(vi, CONS(x, vs))

entries.name: nonempty_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (l0 : List[A])
if
  1. !(LENGTH(l0) == 0)
then
  ∃ (u : A) (U2 : List[A]), l0 == CONS(u, U2)

entries.name: snoc_eq
entries.statement:
∀ (suf l : List[A]) (x : A),
  (APPEND(suf, [x]) == l) == (!(l == NIL) && LAST(l) == x && suf == BUTLAST(l))

entries.name: snoc_eq_sym
entries.statement:
∀ (suf l : List[A]) (x : A),
  (l == APPEND(suf, [x])) == (!(l == NIL) && LAST(l) == x && suf == BUTLAST(l))

entries.name: nil_eq_sym
entries.statement: ∀ (l : List[A]), (NIL == l) == (l == NIL)

entries.name: snoc_cases
entries.statement: ∀ (l : List[A]), l == NIL || (∃ l2 : List[A], ∃ e : A, l == APPEND(l2, [e]))

entries.name: append_len_eq
entries.statement:
∀ (a b c d : List[A])
if
  1. APPEND(a, b) == APPEND(c, d)
  2. LENGTH(b) == LENGTH(d)
then
  a == c
  && b == d

entries.name: all_suffix
entries.statement:
∀ (p : (A) -> Bool) (a b c d : List[A])
if
  1. APPEND(a, b) == APPEND(c, d)
  2. ALL(p, APPEND(a, b))
then
  ALL(p, d)

entries.name: replicate_shift
entries.statement:
∀ (k : Num) (x : A) (l : List[A]),
  APPEND(REPLICATE(k, x), CONS(x, l)) == APPEND(REPLICATE(SUC(k), x), l)

entries.name: val_add_small
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32) (k : Num)
if
  1. val(x) + k < 4294967296
then
  val(word_add(x, word(k))) == val(x) + k

entries.name: val_add_one
entries.statement:
∀ (i n : W32)
if
  1. val(i) < val(n)
then
  val(word_add(i, word(1))) == val(i) + 1

entries.name: val_sub_one
entries.statement:
∀ (c : W32)
if
  1. !(c == word(0))
then
  val(word_sub(c, word(1))) == val(c) - 1

entries.name: hdisj
entries.statement: hdisj((h1 : Heap), (h2 : Heap)) == (∀ x : Num, h1(x) == NONE || h2(x) == NONE)

entries.name: hunion
entries.statement:
hunion((h1 : Heap), (h2 : Heap))
  == ((x : Num) => if h1(x) == NONE { h2(x) } else { h1(x) })

entries.name: star
entries.statement:
star((p : HProp), (q : HProp)) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    ∃ h1 : Heap,
      ∃ h2 : Heap, hdisj(h1, h2) && h == hunion(h1, h2) && p(h1) && q(h2))

entries.name: emp
entries.statement: emp == ((h : Heap) => ∀ x : Num, h(x) == NONE)

entries.name: pts_heap
pts
entries.statement: pts((a : Num), (bs : List[Byte])) == ((h : Heap) => h == pts_heap(a, bs))

entries.name: heap_of
entries.statement:
heap_of((m : Mem))
  == ((x : Num) => if x < LENGTH(SND(m)) { SOME(EL(x, SND(m))) } else { NONE })

entries.name: hdisj_sym
entries.statement: ∀ (h1 h2 : Heap), hdisj(h1, h2) == hdisj(h2, h1)

entries.name: hunion_none
entries.statement:
∀ (h1 h2 : Heap) (x : Num),
  (hunion(h1, h2, x) == NONE) == (h1(x) == NONE && h2(x) == NONE)

entries.name: hunion_comm
entries.statement:
∀ (h1 h2 : Heap)
if
  1. hdisj(h1, h2)
then
  hunion(h1, h2) == hunion(h2, h1)

entries.name: hdisj_union
entries.statement:
∀ (h1 h2 h3 : Heap),
  hdisj(hunion(h1, h2), h3) == (hdisj(h1, h3) && hdisj(h2, h3))

entries.name: hdisj_union_r
entries.statement:
∀ (h1 h2 h3 : Heap),
  hdisj(h1, hunion(h2, h3)) == (hdisj(h1, h2) && hdisj(h1, h3))

entries.name: hunion_assoc
entries.statement: ∀ (h1 h2 h3 : Heap), hunion(hunion(h1, h2), h3) == hunion(h1, hunion(h2, h3))

entries.name: star_comm
entries.statement: ∀ (p q : HProp), star(p, q) == star(q, p)

entries.name: star_assoc
entries.statement: ∀ (p q r : HProp), star(star(p, q), r) == star(p, star(q, r))

entries.name: star_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (p p2 q q2 : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. ∀ h1 : Heap, p(h1) → p2(h1)
  2. ∀ h2 : Heap, q(h2) → q2(h2)
  3. star(p, q, h)
then
  star(p2, q2, h)

entries.name: length_take
entries.statement:
∀ (l : List[A]) (n : Num)
if
  1. n <= LENGTH(l)
then
  LENGTH(take(n, l)) == n

entries.name: el_take
entries.statement:
∀ (l : List[A]) (n i : Num)
if
  1. i < n
  2. n <= LENGTH(l)
then
  EL(i, take(n, l)) == EL(i, l)

entries.name: length_drop
entries.statement: ∀ (l : List[A]) (n : Num), LENGTH(drop(n, l)) == LENGTH(l) - n

entries.name: el_drop
entries.statement:
∀ (l : List[A]) (n i : Num)
if
  1. n + i < LENGTH(l)
then
  EL(i, drop(n, l)) == EL(n + i, l)

entries.name: read_bytes_length
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Mem) (a n : Num)
if
  1. a + n <= LENGTH(SND(m))
then
  LENGTH(read_bytes(m, a, n)) == n

entries.name: read_bytes_el
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Mem) (a n i : Num)
if
  1. a + n <= LENGTH(SND(m))
  2. i < n
then
  EL(i, read_bytes(m, a, n)) == EL(a + i, SND(m))

entries.name: pts_at
entries.statement:
∀ (a x : Num) (bs : List[Byte]) (r : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. star(pts(a, bs), r, h)
  2. a <= x
  3. x < a + LENGTH(bs)
then
  h(x) == SOME(EL(x - a, bs))

entries.name: read_pts
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (bs : List[Byte]) (r : HProp) (m : Mem)
if
  1. star(pts(a, bs), r, heap_of(m))
  2. !(bs == NIL)
then
  a + LENGTH(bs) <= LENGTH(SND(m))
  && read_bytes(m, a, LENGTH(bs)) == bs

entries.name: length_write
entries.statement:
∀ (l bs : List[A]) (a : Num)
if
  1. a + LENGTH(bs) <= LENGTH(l)
then
  LENGTH(APPEND(take(a, l), APPEND(bs, drop(a + LENGTH(bs), l)))) == LENGTH(l)

entries.name: el_write
entries.statement:
∀ (l bs : List[A]) (a x : Num)
if
  1. a + LENGTH(bs) <= LENGTH(l)
  2. x < LENGTH(l)
then
  EL(x, APPEND(take(a, l), APPEND(bs, drop(a + LENGTH(bs), l))))
    == (if a <= x && x < a + LENGTH(bs) { EL(x - a, bs) } else { EL(x, l) })

entries.name: heap_of_write
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Mem) (a : Num) (bs : List[Byte])
if
  1. a + LENGTH(bs) <= LENGTH(SND(m))
then
  heap_of(write_bytes(m, a, bs)) == (
    (x : Num) =>
      if a <= x
      && x < a + LENGTH(bs) { SOME(EL(x - a, bs)) } else { heap_of(m, x) })

entries.name: pts_heap_none
entries.statement:
∀ (a x : Num) (bs : List[Byte]),
  (pts_heap(a, bs, x) == NONE) == !(a <= x && x < a + LENGTH(bs))

entries.name: write_pts
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (bs bs2 : List[Byte]) (r : HProp) (m : Mem)
if
  1. star(pts(a, bs), r, heap_of(m))
  2. LENGTH(bs2) == LENGTH(bs)
  3. !(bs == NIL)
then
  star(pts(a, bs2), r, heap_of(write_bytes(m, a, bs2)))

entries.name: takefill_length
entries.statement: ∀ (l : List[A]) (a : A), takefill(a, LENGTH(l), l) == l

entries.name: load_pts
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Mem) (n off : Num) (bs : List[Byte]) (r : HProp)
if
  1. star(pts(n + off, bs), r, heap_of(m))
  2. !(bs == NIL)
then
  load(m, n, off, LENGTH(bs)) == SOME(bs)

entries.name: store_pts
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Mem) (n off : Num) (bs bs2 : List[Byte]) (r : HProp)
if
  1. star(pts(n + off, bs), r, heap_of(m))
  2. LENGTH(bs2) == LENGTH(bs)
  3. !(bs == NIL)
then
  store(m, n, off, bs2, LENGTH(bs2)) == SOME(write_bytes(m, n + off, bs2))
  && star(pts(n + off, bs2), r, heap_of(write_bytes(m, n + off, bs2)))

entries.name: pts_heap_disj
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (xs ys : List[Byte]),
  hdisj(pts_heap(a, xs), pts_heap(a + LENGTH(xs), ys))

entries.name: pts_heap_append
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (xs ys : List[Byte]),
  pts_heap(a, APPEND(xs, ys))
    == hunion(pts_heap(a, xs), pts_heap(a + LENGTH(xs), ys))

entries.name: pts_split
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (xs ys : List[Byte]),
  pts(a, APPEND(xs, ys)) == star(pts(a, xs), pts(a + LENGTH(xs), ys))

entries.name: safe
entries.statement:
safe(0, (s : Wstore), (f : Wframe), (es : List[Einstr]), (q : Assn)) == true
&& safe(
     SUC((n : Num)),
     (s : Wstore),
     (f : Wframe),
     (es : List[Einstr]),
     (q : Assn)) == (
     (∃ vs : List[Value], es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && q(s, f, vs))
     || (
          ∃ s2 : Wstore,
            ∃ f2 : Wframe, ∃ es2 : List[Einstr], reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2))
        && (
             ∀ s2 : Wstore,
               ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                 ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                   reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → safe(n, s2, f2, es2, q)))

entries.name: triple
entries.statement:
triple((p : Assn), (bs : List[B_e]), (q : Assn)) == (
  ∀ s : Wstore,
    ∀ f : Wframe,
      ∀ vs : List[Value],
        ∀ n : Num,
          p(s, f, vs) → safe(
            n,
            s,
            f,
            APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs)),
            q))

entries.name: gvals
entries.statement:
gvals((s : Wstore), (f : Wframe))
  == MAP((a : Num) => g_val(EL(a, s_globs(s))), inst_globs(f_inst(f)))

entries.name: globs_ok
entries.statement:
globs_ok((s : Wstore), (f : Wframe)) == (
  ∀ i : Num,
    i < LENGTH(inst_globs(f_inst(f))) → EL(i, inst_globs(f_inst(f))) < LENGTH(
      s_globs(s))
    && (
         ∀ k : Num,
           k < LENGTH(inst_globs(f_inst(f)))
           && EL(k, inst_globs(f_inst(f)))
                == EL(i, inst_globs(f_inst(f))) → k
                == i))

entries.name: lift
entries.statement:
lift((p : SAssn), (r : HProp), (s : Wstore), (f : Wframe), (vs : List[Value])) == (
  ∃ j : Num,
    smem_ind(f_inst(f)) == SOME(j)
    && j < LENGTH(s_mems(s))
    && globs_ok(s, f)
    && star(
         p(vs, f_locs(f), gvals(s, f), mem_length(EL(j, s_mems(s)))),
         r,
         heap_of(EL(j, s_mems(s)))))

entries.name: sl_triple
entries.statement:
sl_triple((p : SAssn), (bs : List[B_e]), (q : SAssn))
  == (∀ r : HProp, triple(lift(p, r), bs, lift(q, r)))

entries.name: safe_vals
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs : List[Value]) (q : Assn)
if
  1. q(s, f, vs)
then
  safe(n, s, f, MAP(v_to_e, vs), q)

entries.name: safe_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q q2 : Assn)
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], q(s, f, vs) → q2(s, f, vs)
  2. safe(n, s, f, es, q)
then
  safe(n, s, f, es, q2)

entries.name: triple_conseq
entries.statement:
∀ (p p2 q q2 : Assn) (bs : List[B_e])
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], p2(s, f, vs) → p(s, f, vs)
  2. triple(p, bs, q)
  3. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], q(s, f, vs) → q2(s, f, vs)
then
  triple(p2, bs, q2)

entries.name: lift_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (p p2 : SAssn) (r : HProp) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs vs2 : List[Value])
if
  1. ∀ ls : List[Value],
       ∀ gs : List[Value],
         ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, p(vs, ls, gs, ms, h) → p2(vs2, ls, gs, ms, h)
  2. lift(p, r, s, f, vs)
then
  lift(p2, r, s, f, vs2)

entries.name: map_snoc
entries.statement:
∀ (vs : List[Value]) (v : Value),
  APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [v_to_e(v)]) == MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs, [v]))

entries.name: sl_conseq
entries.statement:
∀ (p p2 q q2 : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ ls : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, p2(vs, ls, gs, ms, h) → p(vs, ls, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple(p, bs, q)
  3. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ ls : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, q(vs, ls, gs, ms, h) → q2(vs, ls, gs, ms, h)
then
  sl_triple(p2, bs, q2)

entries.name: lift_frame
entries.statement:
∀ (p : SAssn) (fr r : HProp),
  lift(
    (vs : List[Value]) => (ls : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) =>
      star(p(vs, ls, gs, ms), fr),
    r)
    == lift(p, star(fr, r))

entries.name: sl_frame
entries.statement:
∀ (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e]) (fr : HProp)
if
  1. sl_triple(p, bs, q)
then
  sl_triple(
    (vs : List[Value]) => (ls : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) =>
      star(p(vs, ls, gs, ms), fr),
    bs,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (ls : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) =>
      star(q(vs, ls, gs, ms), fr))

entries.name: sl_const
entries.statement:
∀ (p : SAssn) (c : V_num),
  sl_triple(
    p,
    [EConstNum(c)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (ls : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, [V_num(c)]) && p(vs0, ls, gs, ms, h))

entries.name: reduce_app
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es1 es2 e1 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(s, f, es1, s2, f2, e1)
then
  reduce(s, f, APPEND(es1, es2), s2, f2, APPEND(e1, es2))

entries.name: trap_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr])
if
  1. trap_top(es)
  2. !(es == [Trap])
then
  reduce(s, f, es, s, f, [Trap])

entries.name: safe_trap
entries.statement: ∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (q : Assn), !safe(SUC(n), s, f, [Trap], q)

entries.name: safe_seq
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es1 es2 : List[Einstr]) (q r : Assn)
if
  1. safe(n, s, f, es1, q)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ m : Num,
             q(s, f, vs) → safe(m, s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), es2), r)
then
  safe(n, s, f, APPEND(es1, es2), r)

entries.name: triple_seq
entries.statement:
∀ (p q r : Assn) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e])
if
  1. triple(p, bs1, q)
  2. triple(q, bs2, r)
then
  triple(p, APPEND(bs1, bs2), r)

entries.name: sl_seq
entries.statement:
∀ (p q r : SAssn) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e])
if
  1. sl_triple(p, bs1, q)
  2. sl_triple(q, bs2, r)
then
  sl_triple(p, APPEND(bs1, bs2), r)

entries.name: is_val_v_to_e
entries.statement: ∀ (v : Value), is_val(v_to_e(v))

entries.name: no_trap
entries.statement:
∀ (suf : List[Einstr]) (b : B_e) (lh : Lholed)
if
  1. Lfilled(0, lh, [Trap], APPEND(suf, [Basic(b)]))
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  false

entries.name: no_trap_x
entries.statement:
∀ (suf : List[Einstr]) (x : Einstr) (lh : Lholed)
if
  1. Lfilled(0, lh, [Trap], APPEND(suf, [x]))
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
  3. !(x == Trap)
then
  false

entries.name: star_pure
entries.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (p r : HProp) (h : Heap),
  star((h1 : Heap) => c && p(h1), r, h) == (c && star(p, r, h))

entries.name: star_ex
entries.statement:
∀ (q : (A, Heap) -> Bool) (r : HProp) (h : Heap),
  star((h1 : Heap) => ∃ vs0 : A, q(vs0, h1), r, h)
    == (∃ vs0 : A, star(q(vs0), r, h))

entries.name: safel
entries.statement:
safel(
  0,
  (s : Wstore),
  (f : Wframe),
  (es : List[Einstr]),
  (q : Assn),
  (l : List[Assn]))
  == true
&& safel(
     SUC((n : Num)),
     (s : Wstore),
     (f : Wframe),
     (es : List[Einstr]),
     (q : Assn),
     (l : List[Assn])) == (
     (∃ vs : List[Value], es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && q(s, f, vs))
     || (
          ∃ i : Num,
            ∃ vs : List[Value],
              ∃ lh : Lholed,
                i < LENGTH(l)
                && es == lfill(
                     lh,
                     APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i + lh_depth(lh)))]))
                && EL(i, l, s, f, vs)
                && (
                     ∀ s2 : Wstore,
                       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                         ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                           reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → safel(
                             n,
                             s2,
                             f2,
                             es2,
                             q,
                             l)))
     || (
          ∃ s2 : Wstore,
            ∃ f2 : Wframe, ∃ es2 : List[Einstr], reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2))
        && (
             ∀ s2 : Wstore,
               ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                 ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                   reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → safel(n, s2, f2, es2, q, l)))

entries.name: triple_l
entries.statement:
triple_l((p : Assn), (bs : List[B_e]), (q : Assn), (l : List[Assn])) == (
  ∀ s : Wstore,
    ∀ f : Wframe,
      ∀ vs : List[Value],
        ∀ n : Num,
          p(s, f, vs) → safel(
            n,
            s,
            f,
            APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs)),
            q,
            l))

entries.name: sl_triple_l
entries.statement:
sl_triple_l((p : SAssn), (bs : List[B_e]), (q : SAssn), (ls : List[SAssn])) == (
  ∀ r : HProp,
    triple_l(lift(p, r), bs, lift(q, r), MAP((x : SAssn) => lift(x, r), ls)))

entries.name: safe_safel
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safe(n, s, f, es, q)
then
  safel(n, s, f, es, q, l)

entries.name: sl_triple_l_of
entries.statement:
∀ (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple(p, bs, q)
then
  sl_triple_l(p, bs, q, ls)

entries.name: safel_trap
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (q : Assn) (l : List[Assn]),
  !safel(SUC(n), s, f, [Trap], q, l)

entries.name: br_not_vals
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (vs : List[Value]) (k : Num),
  !ALL(is_val, lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(k))])))

entries.name: br_not_trap
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (vs : List[Value]) (k : Num),
  !(lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(k))])) == [Trap])

entries.name: safel_seq
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es1 es2 : List[Einstr]) (q r : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safel(n, s, f, es1, q, l)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ m : Num,
             q(s, f, vs) → safel(m, s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), es2), r, l)
then
  safel(n, s, f, APPEND(es1, es2), r, l)

entries.name: triple_l_seq
entries.statement:
∀ (p q r : Assn) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e]) (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. triple_l(p, bs1, q, l)
  2. triple_l(q, bs2, r, l)
then
  triple_l(p, APPEND(bs1, bs2), r, l)

entries.name: sl_seq_l
entries.statement:
∀ (p q r : SAssn) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple_l(p, bs1, q, ls)
  2. sl_triple_l(q, bs2, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(p, APPEND(bs1, bs2), r, ls)

entries.name: safel_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q q2 : Assn)
  (l l2 : List[Assn])
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], q(s, f, vs) → q2(s, f, vs)
  2. LENGTH(l2) == LENGTH(l)
  3. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ s : Wstore,
         ∀ f : Wframe,
           ∀ vs : List[Value],
             i < LENGTH(l) && EL(i, l, s, f, vs) → EL(i, l2, s, f, vs)
  4. safel(n, s, f, es, q, l)
then
  safel(n, s, f, es, q2, l2)

entries.name: triple_l_conseq
entries.statement:
∀ (p p2 q q2 : Assn) (bs : List[B_e]) (l l2 : List[Assn])
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], p2(s, f, vs) → p(s, f, vs)
  2. triple_l(p, bs, q, l)
  3. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], q(s, f, vs) → q2(s, f, vs)
  4. LENGTH(l2) == LENGTH(l)
  5. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ s : Wstore,
         ∀ f : Wframe,
           ∀ vs : List[Value],
             i < LENGTH(l) && EL(i, l, s, f, vs) → EL(i, l2, s, f, vs)
then
  triple_l(p2, bs, q2, l2)

entries.name: sl_conseq_l
entries.statement:
∀ (p p2 q q2 : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e]) (ls ls2 : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, p2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple_l(p, bs, q, ls)
  3. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → q2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  4. LENGTH(ls2) == LENGTH(ls)
  5. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ vs : List[Value],
         ∀ lc : List[Value],
           ∀ gs : List[Value],
             ∀ ms : Num,
               ∀ h : Heap,
                 i < LENGTH(ls)
                 && EL(i, ls, vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → EL(i, ls2, vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
then
  sl_triple_l(p2, bs, q2, ls2)

entries.name: sl_frame_l
entries.statement:
∀ (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn]) (fr : HProp)
if
  1. sl_triple_l(p, bs, q, ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) =>
      star(p(vs, lc, gs, ms), fr),
    bs,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) =>
      star(q(vs, lc, gs, ms), fr),
    MAP(
      (x : SAssn) => (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) =>
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(x(vs, lc, gs, ms), fr),
      ls))

entries.name: nobr_simple
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(APPEND(suf, [Basic(Br((k : Num)))]), e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  false

entries.name: nobr_base
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(s, f, APPEND(suf, [Basic(Br((k : Num)))]), s2, f2, e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  false

entries.name: br_no_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (cs es2 : List[Einstr]) (k : Num)
if
  1. ALL(is_val, cs)
then
  !reduce(s, f, APPEND(cs, [Basic(Br(k))]), s2, f2, es2)

entries.name: sl_br
entries.statement:
∀ (i : Num) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. i < LENGTH(ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
        ∃ vb : List[Value],
          vs == APPEND(vs0, vb) && EL(i, ls, vb, lc, gs, ms, h),
    [Br(i)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      false,
    ls)

entries.name: Steps of a label, blocks and loops (block.mbt, loop.mbt)
v_to_e_inj
entries.statement: ∀ (a b : Value), (v_to_e(a) == v_to_e(b)) == (a == b)

entries.name: map_v_to_e_inj
entries.statement: ∀ (a b : List[Value]), (MAP(v_to_e, a) == MAP(v_to_e, b)) == (a == b)

entries.name: no_trap_label
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (n : Num) (e0 li : List[Einstr]),
  !Lfilled(0, lh, [Trap], [Label(n, e0, li)])

entries.name: label_simple
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Num) (e0 li e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple([Label(m, e0, li)], e2)
then
  ∃ (vs : List[Value]),
    li == MAP(v_to_e, vs)
    && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs)
or
  li == [Trap]
  && e2 == [Trap]
or
  ∃ (vs : List[Value]) (i : Num) (lh : Lholed),
    LENGTH(vs) == m
    && Lfilled(i, lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i))]), li)
    && e2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0)

entries.name: label_base
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (m : Num) (e0 li e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(s, f, [Label(m, e0, li)], s2, f2, e2)
then
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f
  && (∃ vs : List[Value], li == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs))
     || li == [Trap] && e2 == [Trap]
     || (
          ∃ vs : List[Value],
            ∃ i : Num,
              ∃ lh : Lholed,
                LENGTH(vs) == m
                && Lfilled(i, lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i))]), li)
                && e2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0))

entries.name: arity_simple_label
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(
       APPEND(
         suf,
         [Label((m : Num), (e0 : List[Einstr]), (li : List[Einstr]))]),
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: arity_label
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(
         suf,
         [Label((m : Num), (e0 : List[Einstr]), (li : List[Einstr]))]),
       s2,
       f2,
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: label_steps_base
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs0 vsx : List[Value]) (m : Num)
  (e0 li rest e e' : List[Einstr])
if
  1. APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)]) == lfill(LBase(vsx, rest), e)
  2. reduce_base(s, f, e, s2, f2, e')
then
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f
  && lfill(LBase(vsx, rest), e') == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e')
  && (∃ vs : List[Value], li == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && e' == MAP(v_to_e, vs))
     || li == [Trap] && e' == [Trap]
     || (
          ∃ vs : List[Value],
            ∃ i : Num,
              ∃ lh : Lholed,
                LENGTH(vs) == m
                && Lfilled(i, lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i))]), li)
                && e' == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0))

entries.name: label_steps_inside
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs0 vsx : List[Value]) (m n : Num)
  (e0 li e1 rest e e' : List[Einstr]) (l : Lholed)
if
  1. APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)])
       == lfill(LRec(vsx, n, e1, l, rest), e)
  2. reduce_base(s, f, e, s2, f2, e')
then
  reduce(s, f, li, s2, f2, lfill(l, e'))
  && lfill(LRec(vsx, n, e1, l, rest), e')
       == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, lfill(l, e'))])

entries.name: label_steps
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (m : Num)
  (e0 li es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)]), s2, f2, es2)
then
  ∃ (li2 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f, li, s2, f2, li2)
    && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li2)])
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f
  && ∃ e2 : List[Einstr],
       es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e2)
       && (
            (
              ∃ vs : List[Value],
                li == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs))
            || li == [Trap] && e2 == [Trap]
            || (
                 ∃ vs : List[Value],
                   ∃ i : Num,
                     ∃ lh : Lholed,
                       LENGTH(vs) == m
                       && Lfilled(
                            i,
                            lh,
                            APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i))]),
                            li)
                       && e2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0)))

entries.name: first_nonval_eq
entries.statement:
∀ (a b : List[Value]) (h1 h2 : Einstr) (t1 t2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. !is_val(h1)
  2. !is_val(h2)
then
  (APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, a), CONS(h1, t1)) == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, b), CONS(h2, t2)))
    == (a == b && h1 == h2 && t1 == t2)

entries.name: br_unique
entries.statement:
∀ (lh1 lh2 : Lholed) (vs1 vs2 : List[Value]) (k1 k2 : Num)
if
  1. lfill(lh1, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs1), [Basic(Br(k1))]))
       == lfill(lh2, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs2), [Basic(Br(k2))]))
then
  lh_depth(lh1) == lh_depth(lh2)
  && k1 == k2
  && LENGTH(vs1) == LENGTH(vs2) → vs1 == vs2

entries.name: lfilled_label
entries.statement:
∀ (vs0 : List[Value]) (m : Num) (e0 x : List[Einstr]),
  Lfilled(
    1,
    LRec(vs0, m, e0, LBase(NIL, NIL), NIL),
    x,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, x)]))

entries.name: reduce_label
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (m : Num)
  (e0 li li2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(s, f, li, s2, f2, li2)
then
  reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)]),
    s2,
    f2,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li2)]))

entries.name: no_trap_top_snoc
entries.statement:
∀ (cs : List[Einstr]) (x : Einstr)
if
  1. ALL(is_val, cs)
  2. !(x == Trap)
then
  !trap_top(APPEND(cs, [x]))

entries.name: br_no_step2
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (a vs : List[Value]) (k : Num)
  (es2 : List[Einstr]),
  !reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, a), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(k))])),
    s2,
    f2,
    es2)

entries.name: no_trap_top_br
entries.statement:
∀ (a vs : List[Value]) (k : Num),
  !trap_top(APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, a), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(k))])))

entries.name: no_trap_top_label
entries.statement:
∀ (a : List[Value]) (n : Num) (e l : List[Einstr]),
  !trap_top(APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, a), [Label(n, e, l)]))

entries.name: br_stuck
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (vs : List[Value]) (k : Num) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe)
  (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. lh_depth(lh) <= k
then
  !reduce(s, f, lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(k))])), s2, f2, es2)

entries.name: safel_vals
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs : List[Value]) (q : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. q(s, f, vs)
then
  safel(n, s, f, MAP(v_to_e, vs), q, l)

entries.name: label_safe
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (e0 li : List[Einstr]) (qb lb q : Assn) (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safel(n, s, f, li, qb, CONS(lb, l))
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s, f, vs) → q(s, f, APPEND(vs0, vs))
  3. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ k : Num,
             k <= n → lb(s, f, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
             && safel(
                  k,
                  s,
                  f,
                  APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0)),
                  q,
                  l)
then
  safel(n, s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)]), q, l)

entries.name: tbv_results
entries.statement:
tbv_results(NONE) == NIL
&& tbv_results(SOME((t : Valtype))) == [t]

entries.name: tb_tf_tbv
entries.statement:
∀ (i : Inst) (ot : Option[Valtype]),
  tb_tf(i, Tbv(ot)) == Tf(NIL, tbv_results(ot))

entries.name: arity_simple_block
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(
       APPEND(
         suf,
         [Basic(Block(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))]),
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: arity_block
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(
         suf,
         [Basic(Block(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))]),
       s2,
       f2,
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: prefix_block
entries.statement:
∀ (vs0 : List[Value]) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(
         MAP(v_to_e, vs0),
         [Basic(Block(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))]),
       s2,
       f2,
       es2)
then
  ∃ (e : List[Einstr]),
    es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e)
    && reduce(
         s,
         f,
         [Basic(Block(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))],
         s2,
         f2,
         e)

entries.name: block_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (ot : Option[Valtype])
  (bs : List[B_e]),
  reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Basic(Block(Tbv(ot), bs))]),
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(
      MAP(v_to_e, vs0),
      [Label(LENGTH(tbv_results(ot)), NIL, MAP(Basic, bs))]))

entries.name: star_some
entries.statement:
∀ (p r : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. star(p, r, h)
then
  ∃ (h1 : Heap), p(h1)

entries.name: sl_block
entries.statement:
∀ (ot : Option[Valtype]) (bs : List[B_e]) (pb qb lb : SAssn) (ls : List[SAssn])
  (vs0 : List[Value])
if
  1. ∀ r : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num,
             ∀ h : Heap,
               lb(r, lc, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(r) == LENGTH(tbv_results(ot))
  2. sl_triple_l(pb, bs, qb, CONS(lb, ls))
then
  sl_triple_l(
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      vs == vs0 && pb(NIL, lc, gs, ms, h),
    [Block(Tbv(ot), bs)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ r : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, r) && (qb(r, lc, gs, ms, h) || lb(r, lc, gs, ms, h)),
    ls)

entries.name: safel_down
entries.statement:
∀ (n k : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. k <= n
  2. safel(n, s, f, es, q, l)
then
  safel(k, s, f, es, q, l)

entries.name: arity_simple_loop
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(
       APPEND(
         suf,
         [Basic(Loop(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))]),
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: arity_loop
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(
         suf,
         [Basic(Loop(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))]),
       s2,
       f2,
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: prefix_loop
entries.statement:
∀ (vs0 : List[Value]) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(
         MAP(v_to_e, vs0),
         [Basic(Loop(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))]),
       s2,
       f2,
       es2)
then
  ∃ (e : List[Einstr]),
    es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e)
    && reduce(
         s,
         f,
         [Basic(Loop(Tbv((ot : Option[Valtype])), (bs : List[B_e])))],
         s2,
         f2,
         e)

entries.name: loop_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (ot : Option[Valtype])
  (bs : List[B_e]),
  reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Basic(Loop(Tbv(ot), bs))]),
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(
      MAP(v_to_e, vs0),
      [Label(0, [Basic(Loop(Tbv(ot), bs))], MAP(Basic, bs))]))

entries.name: sl_loop
entries.statement:
∀ (ot : Option[Valtype]) (bs : List[B_e]) (linv : FProp) (qb : SAssn)
  (ls : List[SAssn]) (vs0 : List[Value])
if
  1. sl_triple_l(
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         vs == NIL && linv(lc, gs, ms, h),

∀ (h x : A) (t : List[A]) (k : Num),
  list_update(CONS(h, t), k, x)
    == (if k == 0 { CONS(x, t) } else { CONS(h, list_update(t, k - 1, x)) })

entries.name: st_const
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (c : V_num),
  sl_triple(st(v, l, r), [EConstNum(c)], st(APPEND(v, [V_num(c)]), l, r))

entries.name: st_binop
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (t : T_num) (op : Binop) (c1 c2 c : V_num)
if
  1. app_binop(op, c1, c2) == SOME(c)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(c1), V_num(c2)]), l, r),
    [Binop(t, op)],
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(c)]), l, r))

entries.name: st_testop
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (t : T_num) (op : Testop) (c : V_num),
  sl_triple(
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(c)]), l, r),
    [Testop(t, op)],
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(app_testop(op, c))]), l, r))

entries.name: st_unop
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (t : T_num) (op : Unop) (c : V_num),

entries.name: st_relop
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (t : T_num) (op : Relop) (c1 c2 : V_num),

entries.name: st_local_get
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (k : Num)
if
  1. k < LENGTH(l)
then
  sl_triple(st(v, l, r), [Local_get(k)], st(APPEND(v, [EL(k, l)]), l, r))

entries.name: st_local_set
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (k : Num) (c : V_num)
if
  1. k < LENGTH(l)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(c)]), l, r),
    [Local_set(k)],

entries.name: st_drop
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (x : Value),
  sl_triple(st(APPEND(v, [x]), l, r), [Drop], st(v, l, r))

entries.name: st_local_tee
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (r : GProp) (k : Num) (c : V_num)
if
  1. k < LENGTH(l)
then

    [Local_tee(k)],
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(c)]), list_update(l, k, V_num(c)), r))

entries.name: sum_to
entries.statement:
sum_to(0) == 0
&& sum_to(SUC((n : Num))) == SUC(n) + sum_to(n)

entries.name: sum_to_suc_word
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Num),
  (word : (Num) -> W32)(sum_to(SUC(m))) == (word_add : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
    (word : (Num) -> W32)(SUC(m)),
    (word : (Num) -> W32)(sum_to(m)))

entries.name: sum_to_step
entries.statement:
∀ (n : W32)
if
  1. !(n == word(0))
then
  word(sum_to(val(n))) == word_add(n, word(sum_to(val(word_sub(n, word(1))))))

entries.name: sum_to_one_word
entries.statement:
(word : (Num) -> W32)(sum_to((val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(1))))
  == (word : (Num) -> W32)(1)

entries.name: sum_to_zero_word
entries.statement:
(word : (Num) -> W32)(sum_to((val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(0))))
  == (word : (Num) -> W32)(0)

entries.name: num_of_le_bytes
entries.statement: ∀ (k n : Num), num_of_bytes(le_bytes(k, n)) == MOD(n, EXP(256, k))

entries.name: deserialise_serialise_i32
entries.statement: ∀ (v : W32), deserialise_i32(serialise_i32(v)) == v

entries.name: words_bytes
entries.statement:
words_bytes(NIL) == NIL
&& words_bytes(CONS((x : W32), (xs : List[W32])))
     == APPEND(serialise_i32(x), words_bytes(xs))

entries.name: arr
entries.statement: arr((a : Num), (xs : List[W32])) == pts(a, words_bytes(xs))

entries.name: words_bytes_append
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]),
  words_bytes(APPEND(xs, ys)) == APPEND(words_bytes(xs), words_bytes(ys))

entries.name: length_words_bytes
entries.statement: ∀ (xs : List[W32]), LENGTH(words_bytes(xs)) == 4 * LENGTH(xs)

entries.name: arr_split
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (xs ys : List[W32]),
  arr(a, APPEND(xs, ys)) == star(arr(a, xs), arr(a + 4 * LENGTH(xs), ys))

entries.name: arr_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (x : W32) (xs : List[W32]),
  arr(a, CONS(x, xs)) == star(pts(a, serialise_i32(x)), arr(a + 4, xs))

entries.name: star_left_comm
entries.statement: ∀ (p q r : HProp), star(p, star(q, r)) == star(q, star(p, r))

entries.name: arr_focus
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num) (ys zs : List[W32]) (x : W32),
  arr(a, APPEND(ys, CONS(x, zs))) == star(
    pts(a + 4 * LENGTH(ys), serialise_i32(x)),
    star(arr(a, ys), arr(a + 4 * LENGTH(ys) + 4, zs)))

entries.name: star_pure_r
entries.statement:
∀ (c : Bool) (p r : HProp) (h : Heap),
  star(p, (h1 : Heap) => c && r(h1), h) == (c && star(p, r, h))

entries.name: st_arr_store
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (a al off : Num) (ys zs : List[W32]) (x0 k x : W32)
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(k) + off == a + 4 * LENGTH(ys)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(k)), V_num(ConstInt32(x))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(a, APPEND(ys, CONS(x0, zs))), fp(gs, ms), h)),
    [Store(T_i32, NONE, al, off)],
    st(
      v,
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(a, APPEND(ys, CONS(x, zs))), fp(gs, ms), h)))

entries.name: st_arr_load
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (a al off : Num) (ys zs : List[W32]) (x0 k : W32)
  (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(k) + off == a + 4 * LENGTH(ys)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(k))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(a, APPEND(ys, CONS(x0, zs))), fp(gs, ms), h)),
    [Load(T_i32, NONE, al, off)],
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(x0))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(a, APPEND(ys, CONS(x0, zs))), fp(gs, ms), h)))

entries.name: addr_at
entries.statement:
∀ (P J : W32) (N : Num)
if
  1. val(P) + 4 * N < 4294967296
  2. val(J) < N
then
  val(word_add(P, word_mul(J, word(4)))) + 0 == val(P) + 4 * val(J)

entries.name: st_arr_load_at
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (P J : W32) (xs : List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (al : Num)
if
  1. val(P) + 4 * LENGTH(xs) < 4294967296
  2. val(J) < LENGTH(xs)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(P, word_mul(J, word(4)))))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(val(P), xs), fp(gs, ms), h)),
    [Load(T_i32, NONE, al, 0)],
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(EL(val(J), xs)))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(val(P), xs), fp(gs, ms), h)))

entries.name: st_arr_store_at
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (P J x : W32) (xs : List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (al : Num)
if
  1. val(P) + 4 * LENGTH(xs) < 4294967296
  2. val(J) < LENGTH(xs)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      APPEND(
        v,
        [V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(P, word_mul(J, word(4))))),
         V_num(ConstInt32(x))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(val(P), xs), fp(gs, ms), h)),
    [Store(T_i32, NONE, al, 0)],
    st(
      v,
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(arr(val(P), list_update(xs, val(J), x)), fp(gs, ms), h)))

entries.name: st_cell_load
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (a al off : Num) (x0 k : W32) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(k) + off == a
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(k))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>

    st(
      APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(x0))]),
      l,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        star(pts(a, serialise_i32(x0)), fp(gs, ms), h)))

entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (a al off : Num) (x0 k x : W32) (fp : GProp)
if

then
