entries.name: sl_pre_l
entries.statement:
∀ (p p2 q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, p2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple_l(p, bs, q, ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(p2, bs, q, ls)

entries.name: sl_step_l
entries.statement:
∀ (p q r : SAssn) (i : B_e) (rest : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple(p, [i], q)
  2. sl_triple_l(q, rest, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(p, CONS(i, rest), r, ls)

entries.name: sl_cons_l
entries.statement:
∀ (q p r : SAssn) (i : B_e) (rest : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple_l(p, [i], q, ls)
  2. sl_triple_l(q, rest, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(p, CONS(i, rest), r, ls)

entries.name: sl_nil_st
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (r : SAssn) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, R(gs, ms, h) → r(v, l, gs, ms, h)
then
  sl_triple_l(st(v, l, R), NIL, r, ls)

entries.name: sl_br_st
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (i : Num) (r : SAssn) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. i < LENGTH(ls)
  2. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num,
         ∀ h : Heap,
           R(gs, ms, h) → (
             ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
               ∃ vb : List[Value],
                 v == APPEND(vs0, vb) && EL(i, ls, vb, l, gs, ms, h))
then
  sl_triple_l(st(v, l, R), [Br(i)], r, ls)

entries.name: sl_br_if_st
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (i : Num) (rest : List[B_e])
  (r : SAssn) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. !(c == word(0)) → sl_triple_l(
       st(v, l, R),
       [Br(i)],
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         false,
       ls)
  2. c == word(0) → sl_triple_l(st(v, l, R), rest, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(c))]), l, R),
    CONS(Br_if(i), rest),
    r,
    ls)

entries.name: sl_if_st
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (tb : Tb) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e])
  (r : SAssn) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. !(c == word(0)) → sl_triple_l(st(v, l, R), [Block(tb, bs1)], r, ls)
  2. c == word(0) → sl_triple_l(st(v, l, R), [Block(tb, bs2)], r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_l(
    st(APPEND(v, [V_num(ConstInt32(c))]), l, R),
    [If(tb, bs1, bs2)],
    r,
    ls)

entries.name: sl_block_st
entries.statement:
∀ (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (ot : Option[Valtype]) (bs : List[B_e])
  (r : SAssn) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple_l(
       st(NIL, l, R),
       bs,
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         r(APPEND(v, vs), lc, gs, ms, h),
       CONS(
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           LENGTH(vs) == LENGTH(tbv_results(ot))
           && r(APPEND(v, vs), lc, gs, ms, h),
         ls))
then
  sl_triple_l(st(v, l, R), [Block(Tbv(ot), bs)], r, ls)

entries.name: sl_loop_st
entries.statement:
∀ (linv : FProp) (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (ot : Option[Valtype])
  (bs : List[B_e]) (r : SAssn) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, R(gs, ms, h) → linv(l, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple_l(
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         vs == NIL && linv(lc, gs, ms, h),
       bs,
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         r(APPEND(v, vs), lc, gs, ms, h),
       CONS(
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           vs == NIL && linv(lc, gs, ms, h),
         ls))
then
  sl_triple_l(st(v, l, R), [Loop(Tbv(ot), bs)], r, ls)

entries.name: wasm_bool_zero
entries.statement: ∀ (b : Bool), (wasm_bool(b) == word(0)) == !b

entries.name: Calls: call-free code and module triples (calls.mbt)
has_call_b_rules
entries.statement:
∀ j : Num, has_call_b(Call(j))
&& ∀ t : Num, ∀ j : Num, has_call_b(Call_indirect(t, j))
&& ∀ t : Num, has_call_b(Table_set(t))
&& ∀ t : Num, has_call_b(Table_grow(t))
&& ∀ t : Num, ∀ e : Num, has_call_b(Table_init(t, e))
&& ∀ t : Num, ∀ u : Num, has_call_b(Table_copy(t, u))
&& ∀ t : Num, has_call_b(Table_fill(t))
&& ∀ b : B_e,
     ∀ tb : Tb,
       ∀ bs : List[B_e], MEM(b, bs) && has_call_b(b) → has_call_b(Block(tb, bs))
&& ∀ b : B_e,
     ∀ tb : Tb,
       ∀ bs : List[B_e], MEM(b, bs) && has_call_b(b) → has_call_b(Loop(tb, bs))
&& ∀ b : B_e,
     ∀ tb : Tb,
       ∀ bs1 : List[B_e],
         ∀ bs2 : List[B_e],
           MEM(b, bs1) && has_call_b(b) → has_call_b(If(tb, bs1, bs2))
&& ∀ b : B_e,
     ∀ tb : Tb,
       ∀ bs1 : List[B_e],
         ∀ bs2 : List[B_e],
           MEM(b, bs2) && has_call_b(b) → has_call_b(If(tb, bs1, bs2))

entries.name: has_call_b_induct
entries.statement:
∀ (has_call_b' : (B_e) -> Bool) (a : B_e)
if
  1. ∀ j : Num, has_call_b'(Call(j))
  2. ∀ t : Num, ∀ j : Num, has_call_b'(Call_indirect(t, j))
  3. ∀ t : Num, has_call_b'(Table_set(t))
  4. ∀ t : Num, has_call_b'(Table_grow(t))
  5. ∀ t : Num, ∀ e : Num, has_call_b'(Table_init(t, e))
  6. ∀ t : Num, ∀ u : Num, has_call_b'(Table_copy(t, u))
  7. ∀ t : Num, has_call_b'(Table_fill(t))
  8. ∀ b : B_e,
       ∀ tb : Tb,
         ∀ bs : List[B_e],
           MEM(b, bs) && has_call_b'(b) → has_call_b'(Block(tb, bs))
  9. ∀ b : B_e,
       ∀ tb : Tb,
         ∀ bs : List[B_e],
           MEM(b, bs) && has_call_b'(b) → has_call_b'(Loop(tb, bs))
  10. ∀ b : B_e,
        ∀ tb : Tb,
          ∀ bs1 : List[B_e],
            ∀ bs2 : List[B_e],
              MEM(b, bs1) && has_call_b'(b) → has_call_b'(If(tb, bs1, bs2))
  11. ∀ b : B_e,
        ∀ tb : Tb,
          ∀ bs1 : List[B_e],
            ∀ bs2 : List[B_e],
              MEM(b, bs2) && has_call_b'(b) → has_call_b'(If(tb, bs1, bs2))
  12. has_call_b(a)
then
  has_call_b'(a)

entries.name: has_call_b_cases
entries.statement:
∀ (a : B_e),
  has_call_b(a) == (
    (∃ j : Num, a == Call(j))
    || (∃ t : Num, ∃ j : Num, a == Call_indirect(t, j))
    || (∃ t : Num, a == Table_set(t))
    || (∃ t : Num, a == Table_grow(t))
    || (∃ t : Num, ∃ e : Num, a == Table_init(t, e))
    || (∃ t : Num, ∃ u : Num, a == Table_copy(t, u))
    || (∃ t : Num, a == Table_fill(t))
    || (
         ∃ b : B_e,
           ∃ tb : Tb,
             ∃ bs : List[B_e],
               a == Block(tb, bs) && MEM(b, bs) && has_call_b(b))
    || (
         ∃ b : B_e,
           ∃ tb : Tb,
             ∃ bs : List[B_e],
               a == Loop(tb, bs) && MEM(b, bs) && has_call_b(b))
    || (
         ∃ b : B_e,
           ∃ tb : Tb,
             ∃ bs1 : List[B_e],
               ∃ bs2 : List[B_e],
                 a == If(tb, bs1, bs2) && MEM(b, bs1) && has_call_b(b))
    || (
         ∃ b : B_e,
           ∃ tb : Tb,
             ∃ bs1 : List[B_e],
               ∃ bs2 : List[B_e],
                 a == If(tb, bs1, bs2) && MEM(b, bs2) && has_call_b(b)))

entries.name: has_call_rules
entries.statement:
∀ b : B_e, has_call_b(b) → has_call(Basic(b))
&& ∀ a : Num, has_call(Invoke(a))
&& ∀ n : Num, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ es : List[Einstr], has_call(Frame(n, f, es))
&& ∀ e : Einstr,
     ∀ n : Num,
       ∀ es : List[Einstr],
         ∀ les : List[Einstr],
           MEM(e, es) && has_call(e) → has_call(Label(n, es, les))
&& ∀ e : Einstr,
     ∀ n : Num,
       ∀ es : List[Einstr],
         ∀ les : List[Einstr],
           MEM(e, les) && has_call(e) → has_call(Label(n, es, les))

entries.name: has_call_induct
entries.statement:
∀ (has_call' : (Einstr) -> Bool) (a : Einstr)
if
  1. ∀ b : B_e, has_call_b(b) → has_call'(Basic(b))
  2. ∀ a : Num, has_call'(Invoke(a))
  3. ∀ n : Num, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ es : List[Einstr], has_call'(Frame(n, f, es))
  4. ∀ e : Einstr,
       ∀ n : Num,
         ∀ es : List[Einstr],
           ∀ les : List[Einstr],
             MEM(e, es) && has_call'(e) → has_call'(Label(n, es, les))
  5. ∀ e : Einstr,
       ∀ n : Num,
         ∀ es : List[Einstr],
           ∀ les : List[Einstr],
             MEM(e, les) && has_call'(e) → has_call'(Label(n, es, les))
  6. has_call(a)
then
  has_call'(a)

entries.name: has_call_cases
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Einstr),
  has_call(a) == (
    (∃ b : B_e, a == Basic(b) && has_call_b(b))
    || (∃ a' : Num, a == Invoke(a'))
    || (∃ n : Num, ∃ f : Wframe, ∃ es : List[Einstr], a == Frame(n, f, es))
    || (
         ∃ e : Einstr,
           ∃ n : Num,
             ∃ es : List[Einstr],
               ∃ les : List[Einstr],
                 a == Label(n, es, les) && MEM(e, es) && has_call(e))
    || (
         ∃ e : Einstr,
           ∃ n : Num,
             ∃ es : List[Einstr],
               ∃ les : List[Einstr],
                 a == Label(n, es, les) && MEM(e, les) && has_call(e)))

entries.name: call_free
entries.statement: call_free((es : List[Einstr])) == ALL((e : Einstr) => !has_call(e), es)

entries.name: call_free_b
entries.statement: call_free_b((bs : List[B_e])) == ALL((b : B_e) => !has_call_b(b), bs)

entries.name: has_call_b_eq
entries.statement:
∀ (b : B_e),
  has_call_b(b) == (
    (∃ j : Num, b == Call(j))
    || (∃ t : Num, ∃ j : Num, b == Call_indirect(t, j))
    || (∃ t : Num, b == Table_set(t))
    || (∃ t : Num, b == Table_grow(t))
    || (∃ t : Num, ∃ e : Num, b == Table_init(t, e))
    || (∃ t : Num, ∃ u : Num, b == Table_copy(t, u))
    || (∃ t : Num, b == Table_fill(t))
    || (∃ tb : Tb, ∃ bs : List[B_e], b == Block(tb, bs) && EX(has_call_b, bs))
    || (∃ tb : Tb, ∃ bs : List[B_e], b == Loop(tb, bs) && EX(has_call_b, bs))
    || (
         ∃ tb : Tb,
           ∃ bs1 : List[B_e],
             ∃ bs2 : List[B_e],
               b == If(tb, bs1, bs2)
               && (EX(has_call_b, bs1) || EX(has_call_b, bs2))))

entries.name: has_call_eq
entries.statement:
∀ (e : Einstr),
  has_call(e) == (
    (∃ b : B_e, e == Basic(b) && has_call_b(b))
    || (∃ a : Num, e == Invoke(a))
    || (∃ n : Num, ∃ f : Wframe, ∃ es : List[Einstr], e == Frame(n, f, es))
    || (
         ∃ n : Num,
           ∃ es : List[Einstr],
             ∃ les : List[Einstr],
               e == Label(n, es, les)
               && (EX(has_call, es) || EX(has_call, les))))

entries.name: call_free_vals
entries.statement: ∀ (vs : List[Value]), call_free(MAP(v_to_e, vs))

entries.name: call_free_basic
entries.statement: ∀ (bs : List[B_e]), call_free(MAP(Basic, bs)) == call_free_b(bs)

entries.name: call_free_lfill_nil
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (es : List[Einstr]),
  call_free(lfill(lh, es)) == (call_free(lfill(lh, NIL)) && call_free(es))

entries.name: call_free_ctx
entries.statement: call_free_ctx((lh : Lholed)) == call_free(lfill(lh, NIL))

entries.name: call_free_lfill
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (es : List[Einstr]),
  call_free(lfill(lh, es)) == (call_free_ctx(lh) && call_free(es))

entries.name: no_call_v_to_e
entries.statement: ∀ (v : Value), !has_call(v_to_e(v))

entries.name: s_tabs_updates
entries.statement:
s_tabs(s_funcs_update((v0 : List[Cl]), (s : Wstore))) == s_tabs(s)
&& s_tabs(s_mems_update((v2 : List[Mem]), (s : Wstore))) == s_tabs(s)
&& s_tabs(s_globs_update((v3 : List[Global]), (s : Wstore))) == s_tabs(s)
&& s_tabs(s_elems_update((v4 : List[(T_ref, List[V_ref])]), (s : Wstore)))
     == s_tabs(s)
&& s_tabs(s_datas_update((v5 : List[List[Byte]]), (s : Wstore))) == s_tabs(s)

entries.name: s_funcs_updates
entries.statement:
s_funcs(s_tabs_update((v1 : Tabs), (s : Wstore))) == s_funcs(s)
&& s_funcs(s_mems_update((v2 : List[Mem]), (s : Wstore))) == s_funcs(s)
&& s_funcs(s_globs_update((v3 : List[Global]), (s : Wstore))) == s_funcs(s)
&& s_funcs(s_elems_update((v4 : List[(T_ref, List[V_ref])]), (s : Wstore)))
     == s_funcs(s)
&& s_funcs(s_datas_update((v5 : List[List[Byte]]), (s : Wstore))) == s_funcs(s)

entries.name: simple_call_free
entries.statement:
∀ (es es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(es, es2)
  2. call_free(es)
then
  call_free(es2)

entries.name: call_free_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2)
  2. call_free(es)
then
  s_funcs(s2) == s_funcs(s)
  && s_tabs(s2) == s_tabs(s)
  && f_inst(f2) == f_inst(f)
  && call_free(es2)

entries.name: keep
entries.statement:
keep(
  (fs : List[Cl]),
  (tabs : Tabs),
  (inst : Inst),
  (q : Assn),
  (s : Wstore),
  (f : Wframe),
  (vs : List[Value]))
  == (s_funcs(s) == fs && s_tabs(s) == tabs && f_inst(f) == inst && q(s, f, vs))

entries.name: sl_triple_m
entries.statement:
sl_triple_m(
  (fs : List[Cl]),
  (tabs : Tabs),
  (inst : Inst),
  (p : SAssn),
  (bs : List[B_e]),
  (q : SAssn),
  (ls : List[SAssn])) == (
  ∀ r : HProp,
    triple_l(
      keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(p, r)),
      bs,
      keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(q, r)),
      MAP(keep(fs, tabs, inst), MAP((x : SAssn) => lift(x, r), ls))))

entries.name: safel_keep
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn]) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
if
  1. s_funcs(s) == fs
  2. s_tabs(s) == tabs
  3. f_inst(f) == inst
  4. call_free(es)
  5. safel(n, s, f, es, q, l)
then
  safel(n, s, f, es, keep(fs, tabs, inst, q), MAP(keep(fs, tabs, inst), l))

entries.name: sl_triple_m_of
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e])
  (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. call_free_b(bs)
  2. sl_triple_l(p, bs, q, ls)
then
  sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, bs, q, ls)

entries.name: sl_seq_m
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (p q r : SAssn)
  (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, bs1, q, ls)
  2. sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, q, bs2, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, APPEND(bs1, bs2), r, ls)

entries.name: sl_conseq_m
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (p p2 q q2 : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, p2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, bs, q, ls)
  3. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → q2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
then
  sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p2, bs, q2, ls)

entries.name: Adequacy: what a triple says about runs (adequacy.mbt)
safe_step
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es es2 : List[Einstr]) (q : Assn)
if
  1. safe(SUC(n), s, f, es, q)
  2. reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2)
then
  safe(n, s2, f2, es2, q)

entries.name: safe_run
entries.statement:
∀ (c c2 : (Wstore, Wframe, List[Einstr])) (q : Assn) (n : Num)
if
  1. reduce_trans(c, c2)
  2. ∀ n : Num, safe(n, FST(c), FST(SND(c)), SND(SND(c)), q)
then
  safe(n, FST(c2), FST(SND(c2)), SND(SND(c2)), q)

entries.name: safe_progress
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q : Assn)
if
  1. safe(SUC(0), s, f, es, q)
then
  ∃ (vs : List[Value]),
    es == MAP(v_to_e, vs)
    && q(s, f, vs)
or
  ∃ (s2 : Wstore) (f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2)

entries.name: safe_adequate
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es es2 : List[Einstr]) (q : Assn)
if
  1. ∀ n : Num, safe(n, s, f, es, q)
  2. reduce_trans((s, f, es), (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (vs : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs)
    && q(s2, f2, vs)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: sl_triple_adequate
entries.statement:
∀ (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e]) (r : HProp) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe)
  (vs : List[Value]) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. sl_triple(p, bs, q)
  2. lift(p, r, s, f, vs)
  3. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs))),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (vs2 : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs2)
    && lift(q, r, s2, f2, vs2)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: sl_triple_m_adequate
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e])
  (r : HProp) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs : List[Value])
  (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, bs, q, NIL)
  2. s_funcs(s) == fs
  3. s_tabs(s) == tabs
  4. f_inst(f) == inst
  5. lift(p, r, s, f, vs)
  6. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs))),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (vs2 : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs2)
    && s_funcs(s2) == fs
    && s_tabs(s2) == tabs
    && f_inst(f2) == inst
    && lift(q, r, s2, f2, vs2)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: hunion_emp
entries.statement:
∀ (h1 h2 : Heap)
if
  1. ∀ x : Num, h2(x) == NONE
then
  hunion(h1, h2) == h1

entries.name: star_emp_r
entries.statement: ∀ (p : HProp) (h : Heap), star(p, emp, h) == p(h)

entries.name: lift_emp
entries.statement:
∀ (p : SAssn) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs : List[Value]),
  lift(p, emp, s, f, vs) == (
    ∃ j : Num,
      smem_ind(f_inst(f)) == SOME(j)
      && j < LENGTH(s_mems(s))
      && globs_ok(s, f)
      && p(
           vs,
           f_locs(f),
           gvals(s, f),
           mem_length(EL(j, s_mems(s))),
           heap_of(EL(j, s_mems(s)))))

entries.name: sl_triple_m_adequate_whole
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e])
  (j : Num) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs : List[Value])
  (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, bs, q, NIL)
  2. s_funcs(s) == fs
  3. s_tabs(s) == tabs
  4. f_inst(f) == inst
  5. smem_ind(inst) == SOME(j)
  6. j < LENGTH(s_mems(s))
  7. globs_ok(s, f)
  8. p(
       vs,
       f_locs(f),
       gvals(s, f),
       mem_length(EL(j, s_mems(s))),
       heap_of(EL(j, s_mems(s))))
  9. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs))),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (vs2 : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs2)
    && s_funcs(s2) == fs
    && s_tabs(s2) == tabs
    && f_inst(f2) == inst
    && j < LENGTH(s_mems(s2))
    && globs_ok(s2, f2)
    && q(
         vs2,
         f_locs(f2),
         gvals(s2, f2),
         mem_length(EL(j, s_mems(s2))),
         heap_of(EL(j, s_mems(s2))))
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: heap_of_pts_heap
entries.statement: ∀ (m : Mem), heap_of(m) == pts_heap(0, SND(m))

entries.name: pts_heap_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (bs cs : List[Byte]), (pts_heap(0, bs) == pts_heap(0, cs)) == (bs == cs)

entries.name: arr_in_mem
entries.statement:
∀ (a k : Num) (before after : List[Byte]) (ys : List[W32]) (m : Mem)
if
  1. LENGTH(before) == a
  2. LENGTH(ys) == k
then
  star(arr(a, ys), star(pts(0, before), pts(a + 4 * k, after)), heap_of(m))
    == (SND(m) == APPEND(before, APPEND(words_bytes(ys), after)))

entries.name: no_trap_frame
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (n : Num) (f1 : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]),
  !Lfilled(0, lh, [Trap], [Frame(n, f1, es)])

entries.name: frame_simple
entries.statement:
∀ (m : Num) (f1 : Wframe) (es e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple([Frame(m, f1, es)], e2)
then
  ∃ (vs : List[Value]),
    es == MAP(v_to_e, vs)
    && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs)
or
  es == [Trap]
  && e2 == [Trap]
or
  ∃ (vs : List[Value]) (i : Num) (lh : Lholed),
    LENGTH(vs) == m
    && Lfilled(i, lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]), es)
    && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs)

entries.name: frame_base
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (m : Num) (es e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(s, f0, [Frame(m, f1, es)], s2, f2, e2)
then
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && (∃ vs : List[Value], es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs))
     || es == [Trap] && e2 == [Trap]
     || (
          ∃ vs : List[Value],
            ∃ i : Num,
              ∃ lh : Lholed,
                LENGTH(vs) == m
                && Lfilled(i, lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]), es)
                && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs))
or
  ∃ (f1' : Wframe) (es' : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f1, es, s2, f1', es')
    && f2 == f0
    && e2 == [Frame(m, f1', es')]

entries.name: arity_simple_frame
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(
       APPEND(suf, [Frame((m : Num), (f1 : Wframe), (es : List[Einstr]))]),
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: arity_frame
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(suf, [Frame((m : Num), (f1 : Wframe), (es : List[Einstr]))]),
       s2,
       f2,
       e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: frame_steps_base
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (vs0 vsx : List[Value]) (m : Num)
  (es rest e e' : List[Einstr])
if
  1. APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]) == lfill(LBase(vsx, rest), e)
  2. reduce_base(s, f0, e, s2, f2, e')
then
  lfill(LBase(vsx, rest), e') == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e')
  && s2 == s
     && f2 == f0
     && (
          (∃ vs : List[Value], es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && e' == MAP(v_to_e, vs))
          || es == [Trap] && e' == [Trap]
          || (
               ∃ vs : List[Value],
                 ∃ i : Num,
                   ∃ lh : Lholed,
                     LENGTH(vs) == m
                     && Lfilled(
                          i,
                          lh,
                          APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]),
                          es)
                     && e' == MAP(v_to_e, vs)))
     || (
          ∃ f1' : Wframe,
            ∃ es' : List[Einstr],
              reduce(s, f1, es, s2, f1', es')
              && f2 == f0
              && e' == [Frame(m, f1', es')])

entries.name: frame_not_label
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (vs0 vsx : List[Value]) (m n : Num)
  (es e1 rest e e' : List[Einstr]) (l : Lholed)
if
  1. APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)])
       == lfill(LRec(vsx, n, e1, l, rest), e)
  2. reduce_base(s, f0, e, s2, f2, e')
then
  false

entries.name: frame_steps
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (m : Num)
  (es es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)
then
  ∃ (f1' : Wframe) (es' : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f1, es, s2, f1', es')
    && f2 == f0
    && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1', es')])
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && ∃ e2 : List[Einstr],
       es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e2)
       && (
            (
              ∃ vs : List[Value],
                es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs))
            || es == [Trap] && e2 == [Trap]
            || (
                 ∃ vs : List[Value],
                   ∃ i : Num,
                     ∃ lh : Lholed,
                       LENGTH(vs) == m
                       && Lfilled(
                            i,
                            lh,
                            APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]),
                            es)
                       && e2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs)))

entries.name: ret_not_vals
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (vs : List[Value]),
  !ALL(is_val, lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)])))

entries.name: ret_not_trap
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (vs : List[Value]),
  !(lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)])) == [Trap])

entries.name: noret_simple
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(APPEND(suf, [Basic(Return)]), e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  false

entries.name: noret_base
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(s, f, APPEND(suf, [Basic(Return)]), s2, f2, e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  false

entries.name: ret_no_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (cs es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. ALL(is_val, cs)
then
  !reduce(s, f, APPEND(cs, [Basic(Return)]), s2, f2, es2)

entries.name: ret_no_step2
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (a vs : List[Value]) (es2 : List[Einstr]),
  !reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, a), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)])),
    s2,
    f2,
    es2)

entries.name: no_trap_top_ret
entries.statement:
∀ (a vs : List[Value]),
  !trap_top(APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, a), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)])))

entries.name: br_ret_distinct
entries.statement:
∀ (lh1 lh2 : Lholed) (vs1 vs2 : List[Value]) (k : Num),
  !(
    lfill(lh1, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs1), [Basic(Br(k))]))
      == lfill(lh2, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs2), [Basic(Return)])))

entries.name: return_stuck
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (vs : List[Value]) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe)
  (es2 : List[Einstr]),
  !reduce(
    s,
    f,
    lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)])),
    s2,
    f2,
    es2)

entries.name: reduce_after_vals
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (e e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(s, f, e, s2, f2, e2)
then
  reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e),
    s2,
    f2,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e2))

entries.name: vals_not_trap
entries.statement: ∀ (vs : List[Value]), !(MAP(v_to_e, vs) == [Trap])

entries.name: ret_not_map
entries.statement:
∀ (lh : Lholed) (vs vs2 : List[Value]),
  !(lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)])) == MAP(v_to_e, vs2))

entries.name: frame_can_step
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es : List[Einstr]) (qin : Assn)
if
  1. safel(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL)
then
  ∃ (s2 : Wstore) (f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)

entries.name: frame_next
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s s2 : Wstore) (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es es2 : List[Einstr]) (qin : Assn)
if
  1. safel(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL)
  2. reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)
then
  ∃ (f1' : Wframe) (es' : List[Einstr]),
    safel(n, s2, f1', es', qin, NIL)
    && f2 == f0
    && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1', es')])
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && ∃ vs : List[Value], es2 == MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs0, vs)) && qin(s, f1, vs)

entries.name: frame_safe
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es : List[Einstr]) (qin q : Assn) (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safel(n, s, f1, es, qin, NIL)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs2 : List[Value], qin(s2, f2, vs2) → q(s2, f0, APPEND(vs0, vs2))
then
  safel(n, s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), q, l)

entries.name: arity_simple_call
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(APPEND(suf, [Basic(Call((j : Num)))]), e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: arity_call
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_base(s, f, APPEND(suf, [Basic(Call((j : Num)))]), s2, f2, e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  LENGTH(suf) == 0

entries.name: prefix_call
entries.statement:
∀ (vs0 : List[Value]) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Basic(Call((j : Num)))]),
       s2,
       f2,
       es2)
then
  ∃ (e : List[Einstr]),
    es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), e)
    && reduce(s, f, [Basic(Call((j : Num)))], s2, f2, e)

entries.name: call_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (j : Num)
  (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce(s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Basic(Call(j))]), s2, f2, es2)
then
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f
  && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Invoke(sfunc_ind(f_inst(f), j))])

entries.name: call_can_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value]) (j : Num),
  reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Basic(Call(j))]),
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Invoke(sfunc_ind(f_inst(f), j))]))

entries.name: noinvoke_simple
entries.statement:
∀ (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. reduce_simple(APPEND(suf, [Invoke((a : Num))]), e2)
  2. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  false

entries.name: invoke_base
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (a : Num) (i : Inst)
  (t1s t2s ts : List[Valtype]) (es : List[B_e]) (zs : List[Value])
  (suf e2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. EL(a, s_funcs(s)) == Func_native(i, Tf(t1s, t2s), ts, es)
  2. n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  3. reduce_base(s, f, APPEND(suf, [Invoke(a)]), s2, f2, e2)
  4. ALL(is_val, suf)
then
  ∃ (vcs : List[Value]),
    suf == MAP(v_to_e, vcs)
    && LENGTH(vcs) == LENGTH(t1s)
    && s2 == s
    && f2 == f
    && e2 == [
         Frame(
           LENGTH(t2s),
           Wframe(APPEND(vcs, zs), i),
           [Label(LENGTH(t2s), NIL, MAP(Basic, es))])]

entries.name: invoke_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (vs0 args zs : List[Value]) (a : Num)
  (i : Inst) (t1s t2s ts : List[Valtype]) (es : List[B_e]) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. EL(a, s_funcs(s)) == Func_native(i, Tf(t1s, t2s), ts, es)
  2. n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  3. LENGTH(args) == LENGTH(t1s)
  4. reduce(
       s,
       f,
       APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs0, args)), [Invoke(a)]),
       s2,
       f2,
       es2)
then
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f
  && es2 == APPEND(
       MAP(v_to_e, vs0),
       [
         Frame(
           LENGTH(t2s),
           Wframe(APPEND(args, zs), i),
           [Label(LENGTH(t2s), NIL, MAP(Basic, es))])])

entries.name: invoke_can_step
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs0 args zs : List[Value]) (a : Num) (i : Inst)
  (t1s t2s ts : List[Valtype]) (es : List[B_e])
if
  1. EL(a, s_funcs(s)) == Func_native(i, Tf(t1s, t2s), ts, es)
  2. n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  3. LENGTH(args) == LENGTH(t1s)
then
  reduce(
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs0, args)), [Invoke(a)]),
    s,
    f,
    APPEND(
      MAP(v_to_e, vs0),
      [
        Frame(
          LENGTH(t2s),
          Wframe(APPEND(args, zs), i),
          [Label(LENGTH(t2s), NIL, MAP(Basic, es))])]))

entries.name: call_safe
entries.statement:
∀ (n j : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs0 args zs : List[Value]) (i : Inst)
  (t1s t2s ts : List[Valtype]) (es : List[B_e]) (qin q : Assn) (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(f_inst(f), j), s_funcs(s))
       == Func_native(i, Tf(t1s, t2s), ts, es)
  2. n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  3. LENGTH(args) == LENGTH(t1s)
  4. ∀ k : Num,
       safel(
         k,
         s,
         Wframe(APPEND(args, zs), i),
         [Label(LENGTH(t2s), NIL, MAP(Basic, es))],
         qin,
         NIL)
  5. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value], qin(s2, f2, vs) → q(s2, f, APPEND(vs0, vs))
then
  safel(n, s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs0, args)), [Basic(Call(j))]), q, l)

entries.name: label_safe_top
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (li : List[Einstr]) (qb : Assn)
if
  1. safel(n, s, f, li, qb, [qb])
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  safel(n, s, f, [Label(m, NIL, li)], qb, NIL)

entries.name: sl_call
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (j : Num)
  (t1s t2s ts : List[Valtype]) (es : List[B_e]) (zs vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
  (P Q : FProp) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, j), fs) == Func_native(inst, Tf(t1s, t2s), ts, es)
  2. n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  3. ∀ args : List[Value],
       LENGTH(args) == LENGTH(t1s) → sl_triple_m(
         fs,
         tabs,
         inst,
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           vs == NIL && lc == APPEND(args, zs) && P(args, gs, ms, h),
         es,
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           Q(vs, gs, ms, h),
         [
           (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
           (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             Q(vs, gs, ms, h)])
  4. ∀ res : List[Value],
       ∀ gs : List[Value],
         ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, Q(res, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(res) == LENGTH(t2s)
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && LENGTH(args) == LENGTH(t1s)
        && lc == lc0
        && P(args, gs, ms, h),
    [Call(j)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res) && lc == lc0 && Q(res, gs, ms, h),
    ls)

entries.name: safer
entries.statement:
safer(
  0,
  (s : Wstore),
  (f : Wframe),
  (es : List[Einstr]),
  (q : Assn),
  (l : List[Assn]),
  (rq : Assn))
  == true
&& safer(
     SUC((n : Num)),
     (s : Wstore),
     (f : Wframe),
     (es : List[Einstr]),
     (q : Assn),
     (l : List[Assn]),
     (rq : Assn)) == (
     (∃ vs : List[Value], es == MAP(v_to_e, vs) && q(s, f, vs))
     || (
          ∃ i : Num,
            ∃ vs : List[Value],
              ∃ lh : Lholed,
                i < LENGTH(l)
                && es == lfill(
                     lh,
                     APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i + lh_depth(lh)))]))
                && EL(i, l, s, f, vs)
                && (
                     ∀ s2 : Wstore,
                       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                         ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                           reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → safer(
                             n,
                             s2,
                             f2,
                             es2,
                             q,
                             l,
                             rq)))
     || (
          ∃ vs : List[Value],
            ∃ lh : Lholed,
              es == lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]))
              && rq(s, f, vs))
     || (
          ∃ s2 : Wstore,
            ∃ f2 : Wframe, ∃ es2 : List[Einstr], reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2))
        && (
             ∀ s2 : Wstore,
               ∀ f2 : Wframe,
                 ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
                   reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → safer(
                     n,
                     s2,
                     f2,
                     es2,
                     q,
                     l,
                     rq)))

entries.name: safer_vals
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs : List[Value]) (q rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. q(s, f, vs)
then
  safer(n, s, f, MAP(v_to_e, vs), q, l, rq)

entries.name: safel_safer
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safel(n, s, f, es, q, l)
then
  safer(n, s, f, es, q, l, rq)

entries.name: safer_safel
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], !rq(s, f, vs)
  2. safer(n, s, f, es, q, l, rq)
then
  safel(n, s, f, es, q, l)

entries.name: safer_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q q2 rq rq2 : Assn)
  (l l2 : List[Assn])
if
  1. ∀ s : Wstore, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], q(s, f, vs) → q2(s, f, vs)
  2. LENGTH(l2) == LENGTH(l)
  3. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ s : Wstore,
         ∀ f : Wframe,
           ∀ vs : List[Value],
             i < LENGTH(l) && EL(i, l, s, f, vs) → EL(i, l2, s, f, vs)
  4. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rq(s, f, vs) → rq2(s, f, vs)
  5. safer(n, s, f, es, q, l, rq)
then
  safer(n, s, f, es, q2, l2, rq2)

entries.name: safer_down
entries.statement:
∀ (n k : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es : List[Einstr]) (q rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. k <= n
  2. safer(n, s, f, es, q, l, rq)
then
  safer(k, s, f, es, q, l, rq)

entries.name: safer_trap
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (q rq : Assn) (l : List[Assn]),
  !safer(SUC(n), s, f, [Trap], q, l, rq)

entries.name: safer_det_step
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es es1 : List[Einstr]) (q rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. reduce(s, f, es, s, f, es1)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ es2 : List[Einstr],
           reduce(s, f, es, s2, f2, es2) → s2 == s && f2 == f && es2 == es1
  3. safer(n, s, f, es1, q, l, rq)
then
  safer(SUC(n), s, f, es, q, l, rq)

entries.name: safer_seq
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (es1 es2 : List[Einstr]) (q r rq : Assn)
  (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safer(n, s, f, es1, q, l, rq)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ m : Num,
             m <= n → q(s, f, vs) → safer(
               m,
               s,
               f,
               APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), es2),
               r,
               l,
               rq)
then
  safer(n, s, f, APPEND(es1, es2), r, l, rq)

entries.name: ret_unique
entries.statement:
∀ (lh1 lh2 : Lholed) (vs1 vs2 : List[Value])
if
  1. lfill(lh1, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs1), [Basic(Return)]))
       == lfill(lh2, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs2), [Basic(Return)]))
then
  lh_depth(lh1) == lh_depth(lh2)
  && LENGTH(vs1) == LENGTH(vs2) → vs1 == vs2

entries.name: ret_frame_case
entries.statement:
∀ (lh lh2 : Lholed) (vs vs2 : List[Value]) (m : Num) (rin : Assn) (s : Wstore)
  (f : Wframe)
if
  1. lfill(lh, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]))
       == lfill(lh2, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs2), [Basic(Return)]))
  2. rin(s, f, vs)
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ v : List[Value], rin(s2, f2, v) → LENGTH(v) == m
  4. LENGTH(vs2) == m
then
  rin(s, f, vs2)

entries.name: safer_label
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (e0 li : List[Einstr]) (qb lb q rq : Assn) (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safer(n, s, f, li, qb, CONS(lb, l), rq)
  2. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s, f, vs) → q(s, f, APPEND(vs0, vs))
  3. ∀ s : Wstore,
       ∀ f : Wframe,
         ∀ vs : List[Value],
           ∀ k : Num,
             k <= n → lb(s, f, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
             && safer(
                  k,
                  s,
                  f,
                  APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), e0)),
                  q,
                  l,
                  rq)
then
  safer(n, s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Label(m, e0, li)]), q, l, rq)

entries.name: safer_label_top
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f : Wframe) (li : List[Einstr]) (qb rb : Assn)
if
  1. safer(n, s, f, li, qb, [qb], rb)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], qb(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  safer(n, s, f, [Label(m, NIL, li)], qb, NIL, rb)

entries.name: frame_can_step_r
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es : List[Einstr]) (qin rin : Assn)
if
  1. safer(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rin(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  ∃ (s2 : Wstore) (f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)

entries.name: frame_next_r
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s s2 : Wstore) (f0 f1 f2 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es es2 : List[Einstr]) (qin rin : Assn)
if
  1. safer(SUC(n), s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin)
  2. reduce(s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), s2, f2, es2)
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe, ∀ vs : List[Value], rin(s2, f2, vs) → LENGTH(vs) == m
then
  ∃ (f1' : Wframe) (es' : List[Einstr]),
    safer(n, s2, f1', es', qin, NIL, rin)
    && f2 == f0
    && es2 == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1', es')])
or
  s2 == s
  && f2 == f0
  && ∃ vs : List[Value],
       es2 == MAP(v_to_e, APPEND(vs0, vs)) && (qin(s, f1, vs) || rin(s, f1, vs))

entries.name: frame_safe_r
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (s : Wstore) (f0 f1 : Wframe) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es : List[Einstr]) (qin rin q rq : Assn) (l : List[Assn])
if
  1. safer(n, s, f1, es, qin, NIL, rin)
  2. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs2 : List[Value], qin(s2, f2, vs2) → q(s2, f0, APPEND(vs0, vs2))
  3. ∀ s2 : Wstore,
       ∀ f2 : Wframe,
         ∀ vs2 : List[Value],
           rin(s2, f2, vs2) → LENGTH(vs2) == m && q(s2, f0, APPEND(vs0, vs2))
then
  safer(n, s, f0, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs0), [Frame(m, f1, es)]), q, l, rq)

entries.name: inv_ok
entries.statement:
inv_ok(
  (n : Num),
  (fs : List[Cl]),
  (tabs : Tabs),
  (inst : Inst),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  ∀ m : Num,
    ∀ fr : HProp,
      ∀ s : Wstore,
        ∀ f : Wframe,
          ∀ stk : List[Value],
            ∀ vs0 : List[Value],
              ∀ lc0 : List[Value],
                ∀ l : List[Assn],
                  ∀ rq : Assn,
                    m <= n
                    && keep(
                         fs,
                         tabs,
                         inst,
                         lift(
                           (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) =>
                           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
                             ∃ args : List[Value],
                               vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
                               && lc == lc0
                               && P(args, gs, ms, h),
                           fr),
                         s,
                         f,
                         stk) → safer(
                         m,
                         s,
                         f,
                         APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, stk), [Invoke(a)]),
                         keep(
                           fs,
                           tabs,
                           inst,
                           lift(
                             (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) =>
                             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
                             (h : Heap) =>
                               ∃ res : List[Value],
                                 vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
                                 && lc == lc0
                                 && Q(res, gs, ms, h),
                             fr)),
                         l,
                         rq))

entries.name: specs_ok
entries.statement:
specs_ok((n : Num), (G : Specs), (fs : List[Cl]), (tabs : Tabs), (inst : Inst)) == (
  ∀ a : Num,
    ∀ P : FProp, ∀ Q : FProp, G(a, P, Q) → inv_ok(n, fs, tabs, inst, a, P, Q))

entries.name: sl_triple_g
entries.statement:
sl_triple_g(
  (G : Specs),
  (fs : List[Cl]),
  (tabs : Tabs),
  (inst : Inst),
  (rp : SAssn),
  (p : SAssn),
  (bs : List[B_e]),
  (q : SAssn),
  (ls : List[SAssn])) == (
  ∀ n : Num,
    ∀ fr : HProp,
      ∀ s : Wstore,
        ∀ f : Wframe,
          ∀ vs : List[Value],
            specs_ok(n, G, fs, tabs, inst)
            && keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(p, fr), s, f, vs) → safer(
                 n,
                 s,
                 f,
                 APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), MAP(Basic, bs)),
                 keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(q, fr)),
                 MAP(
                   keep(fs, tabs, inst),
                   MAP((x : SAssn) => lift(x, fr), ls)),
                 keep(fs, tabs, inst, lift(rp, fr))))

entries.name: specs_down
entries.statement:
∀ (n m : Num) (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
if
  1. m <= n
  2. specs_ok(n, G, fs, tabs, inst)
then
  specs_ok(m, G, fs, tabs, inst)

entries.name: sl_triple_g_of_m
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p q : SAssn)

if
  1. sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, bs, q, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, bs, q, ls)

entries.name: sl_triple_g_of
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p q : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. call_free_b(bs)
  2. sl_triple_l(p, bs, q, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, bs, q, ls)

entries.name: sl_triple_m_of_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (p q : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ n : Num, specs_ok(n, G, fs, tabs, inst)
  2. sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         false,

then
  sl_triple_m(fs, tabs, inst, p, bs, q, ls)

entries.name: sl_seq_g
entries.statement:

if
  1. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, bs1, q, ls)
  2. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, q, bs2, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, APPEND(bs1, bs2), r, ls)

entries.name: sl_conseq_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p p2 q q2 : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls ls2 : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, p2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, bs, q, ls)
  3. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → q2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  4. LENGTH(ls2) == LENGTH(ls)
  5. ∀ i : Num,
       ∀ vs : List[Value],
         ∀ lc : List[Value],
           ∀ gs : List[Value],
             ∀ ms : Num,
               ∀ h : Heap,
                 i < LENGTH(ls)
                 && EL(i, ls, vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → EL(i, ls2, vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p2, bs, q2, ls2)

entries.name: sl_conseq_ret_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp rp2 p q : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num,
             ∀ h : Heap, rp(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → rp2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, bs, q, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp2, p, bs, q, ls)

entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp q : SAssn)
  (pp : (A, List[Value], List[Value], List[Value], Num, Heap) -> Bool)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if

then
  sl_triple_g(

entries.name: sl_pure_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p q : SAssn)
  (c : Bool) (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if

    rp,

entries.name: sl_br_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn) (i : Num)

if

then
  sl_triple_g(

    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
        ∃ vb : List[Value],
          vs == APPEND(vs0, vb) && EL(i, ls, vb, lc, gs, ms, h),
    [Br(i)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      false,
    ls)

entries.name: sl_return_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)

  sl_triple_g(

    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
        ∃ vb : List[Value], vs == APPEND(vs0, vb) && rp(vb, lc, gs, ms, h),
    [Return],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      false,
    ls)

entries.name: in_mod
entries.statement:
in_mod(
  (fs : List[Cl]),
  (tabs : Tabs),
  (inst : Inst),
  (s : Wstore),
  (f : Wframe))
  == (s_funcs(s) == fs && s_tabs(s) == tabs && f_inst(f) == inst)

entries.name: keep_in_mod
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (q : Assn) (s : Wstore)
  (f : Wframe) (vs : List[Value]),
  keep(fs, tabs, inst, q, s, f, vs)
    == (in_mod(fs, tabs, inst, s, f) && q(s, f, vs))

entries.name: sl_br_if_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p q : SAssn)
  (ls : List[SAssn]) (i : Num) (c : W32)
if
  1. !(c == word(0)) → sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, [Br(i)], q, ls)
  2. c == word(0) → (
       ∀ vs : List[Value],
         ∀ lc : List[Value],
           ∀ gs : List[Value],
             ∀ ms : Num,
               ∀ h : Heap, p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → q(vs, lc, gs, ms, h))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, [V_num(ConstInt32(c))]) && p(vs0, lc, gs, ms, h),
    [Br_if(i)],
    q,
    ls)

entries.name: sl_if_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p q : SAssn)
  (ls : List[SAssn]) (tb : Tb) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e]) (c : W32)
if
  1. !(c == word(0)) → sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       p,
       [Block(tb, bs1)],
       q,
       ls)
  2. c == word(0) → sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       p,
       [Block(tb, bs2)],
       q,
       ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, [V_num(ConstInt32(c))]) && p(vs0, lc, gs, ms, h),
    [If(tb, bs1, bs2)],
    q,
    ls)

entries.name: sl_block_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp pb qb lb : SAssn)
  (ot : Option[Valtype]) (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn]) (vs0 : List[Value])
if
  1. ∀ r : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num,
             ∀ h : Heap,
               lb(r, lc, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(r) == LENGTH(tbv_results(ot))
  2. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, pb, bs, qb, CONS(lb, ls))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      vs == vs0 && pb(NIL, lc, gs, ms, h),
    [Block(Tbv(ot), bs)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ r : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, r) && (qb(r, lc, gs, ms, h) || lb(r, lc, gs, ms, h)),
    ls)

entries.name: sl_loop_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp qb : SAssn)
  (ot : Option[Valtype]) (bs : List[B_e]) (linv : FProp) (ls : List[SAssn])
  (vs0 : List[Value])
if
  1. sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
       (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         vs == NIL && linv(lc, gs, ms, h),
       bs,
       qb,
       CONS(
         (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
         (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           vs == NIL && linv(lc, gs, ms, h),
         ls))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      vs == vs0 && linv(lc, gs, ms, h),
    [Loop(Tbv(ot), bs)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ r : List[Value], vs == APPEND(vs0, r) && qb(r, lc, gs, ms, h),
    ls)

entries.name: sl_call_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn) (j : Num)
  (P Q : FProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. G(sfunc_ind(inst, j), P, Q)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args) && lc == lc0 && P(args, gs, ms, h),
    [Call(j)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res) && lc == lc0 && Q(res, gs, ms, h),
    ls)

entries.name: sl_funs_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (n : Num)
if
  1. ∀ a : Num,
       ∀ P : FProp,
         ∀ Q : FProp,
           G(a, P, Q) → (
             ∃ t1s : List[Valtype],
               ∃ t2s : List[Valtype],
                 ∃ ts : List[Valtype],
                   ∃ es : List[B_e],
                     ∃ zs : List[Value],
                       EL(a, fs) == Func_native(inst, Tf(t1s, t2s), ts, es)
                       && n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
                       && (
                            ∀ args : List[Value],
                              ∀ gs : List[Value],
                                ∀ ms : Num,
                                  ∀ h : Heap,
                                    P(args, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(args)
                                      == LENGTH(t1s))
                       && (
                            ∀ res : List[Value],
                              ∀ gs : List[Value],
                                ∀ ms : Num,
                                  ∀ h : Heap,
                                    Q(res, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(res)
                                      == LENGTH(t2s))
                       && (
                            ∀ args : List[Value],
                              sl_triple_g(
                                G,
                                fs,
                                tabs,
                                inst,
                                (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) =>
                                (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
                                (h : Heap) =>
                                  Q(vs, gs, ms, h),
                                (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) =>
                                (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
                                (h : Heap) =>
                                  vs == NIL
                                  && lc == APPEND(args, zs)
                                  && P(args, gs, ms, h),
                                es,
                                (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) =>
                                (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
                                (h : Heap) =>
                                  Q(vs, gs, ms, h),
                                [
                                  (vs : List[Value]) =>
                                  (lc : List[Value]) =>
                                  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
                                  (h : Heap) =>
                                    Q(vs, gs, ms, h)])))
then
  specs_ok(n, G, fs, tabs, inst)

entries.name: sl_step_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p q r : SAssn)
  (i : B_e) (rest : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple(p, [i], q)
  2. call_free_b([i])
  3. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, q, rest, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, CONS(i, rest), r, ls)

entries.name: sl_pre_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp p p2 q : SAssn)
  (bs : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ vs : List[Value],
       ∀ lc : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, p2(vs, lc, gs, ms, h) → p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h)
  2. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, bs, q, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p2, bs, q, ls)

entries.name: sl_cons_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp q p r : SAssn)
  (i : B_e) (rest : List[B_e]) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, [i], q, ls)
  2. sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, q, rest, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, p, CONS(i, rest), r, ls)

entries.name: sl_nil_st_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp r : SAssn)
  (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, R(gs, ms, h) → r(v, l, gs, ms, h)
then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(v, l, R), NIL, r, ls)

entries.name: sl_br_st_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp r : SAssn)
  (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (i : Num) (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. i < LENGTH(ls)
  2. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num,
         ∀ h : Heap,
           R(gs, ms, h) → (
             ∃ vs0 : List[Value],
               ∃ vb : List[Value],
                 v == APPEND(vs0, vb) && EL(i, ls, vb, l, gs, ms, h))

entries.name: sl_br_if_st_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp r : SAssn)
  (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (i : Num) (rest : List[B_e])
  (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. !(c == word(0)) → sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       st(v, l, R),
       [Br(i)],
       (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>

  2. c == word(0) → sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(v, l, R), rest, r, ls)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,

∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp r : SAssn)
  (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (tb : Tb) (bs1 bs2 : List[B_e])

if

entries.name: sl_block_st_g
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp r : SAssn)
  (v l : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (ot : Option[Valtype]) (bs : List[B_e])
  (ls : List[SAssn])
if
  1. sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       st(NIL, l, R),
       bs,

           LENGTH(vs) == LENGTH(tbv_results(ot))
           && r(APPEND(v, vs), lc, gs, ms, h),

then
  sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(v, l, R), [Block(Tbv(ot), bs)], r, ls)

entries.name: sum_code
entries.statement:
sum_code ==
  local.get 0
  if
    loop
      local.get 1
      local.get 0
      i32.add
      local.set 1
      local.get 0
      i32.const 1
      i32.sub
      local.set 0
      local.get 0
      br_if 0
    end
  end

entries.name: sum_inv_step
entries.statement:
∀ (n acc a : W32)
if
  1. !(n == word(0))
  2. word_add(acc, word(sum_to(val(n)))) == a
then
  word_add(word_add(acc, n), word(sum_to(val(word_sub(n, word(1)))))) == a

entries.name: word_add_val
entries.statement:
∀ (a b : W32) (k : Num)
if
  1. val(a) + 4 == val(b) + k
then
  word_add(a, word(4)) == word_add(b, word(k))

entries.name: fill_entry
entries.statement:
∀ (m : W32) (ys : List[W32])
if
  1. !(m == word(0))
  2. LENGTH(ys) == val(m)
then
  ∃ (y : W32) (zs : List[W32]),
    ys == CONS(y, zs)
    && SUC(LENGTH(zs)) == val(m)

entries.name: fill_step
entries.statement:
∀ (p0 m p c x : W32) (zs : List[W32])
if
  1. val(p0) + 4 * val(m) < 4294967296
  2. !(c == word(0))
  3. !(word_sub(c, word(1)) == word(0))
  4. val(p) == val(p0) + 4 * (val(m) - val(c))
  5. val(c) <= val(m)
  6. SUC(LENGTH(zs)) == val(c)
then
  ∃ (y2 : W32) (zs2 : List[W32]),
    zs == CONS(y2, zs2)
    && val(word_add(p, word(4)))
         == val(p0) + 4 * (val(m) - val(word_sub(c, word(1))))
    && val(word_sub(c, word(1))) <= val(m)
    && SUC(LENGTH(zs2)) == val(word_sub(c, word(1)))
    && APPEND(REPLICATE(val(m) - val(word_sub(c, word(1))), x), CONS(y2, zs2))
         == APPEND(REPLICATE(val(m) - val(c), x), CONS(x, zs))

entries.name: fill_exit
entries.statement:
∀ (p0 m p c x : W32) (zs : List[W32])
if
  1. word_sub(c, word(1)) == word(0)
  2. val(p) == val(p0) + 4 * (val(m) - val(c))
  3. val(c) <= val(m)
  4. SUC(LENGTH(zs)) == val(c)
then
  word_add(p, word(4)) == word_add(p0, word(4 * val(m)))
  && REPLICATE(val(m), x) == APPEND(REPLICATE(val(m) - val(c), x), CONS(x, zs))

entries.name: fill_code
entries.statement:
fill_code((x : W32)) ==
  local.get 1
  if
    loop
      local.get 0
      i32.const x
      i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
      local.get 0
      i32.const 4
      i32.add
      local.set 0
      local.get 1
      i32.const 1
      i32.sub
      local.set 1
      local.get 1
      br_if 0
    end
  end

entries.name: example_fill
entries.statement:
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (vs0 : List[Value]) (p0 m x : W32) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. LENGTH(ys) == val(m)
  2. val(p0) + 4 * val(m) < 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      vs0,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p0)), V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => star(arr(val(p0), ys), fp(gs, ms))),
    fill_code(x),
    st(
      vs0,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(p0, word(4 * val(m))))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(arr(val(p0), REPLICATE(val(m), x)), fp(gs, ms))))

entries.name: wsum
entries.statement:
wsum(NIL) == word(0)
&& wsum(CONS((x : W32), (xs : List[W32]))) == word_add(x, wsum(xs))

entries.name: wsum_snoc
entries.statement: ∀ (ys : List[W32]) (y : W32), wsum(APPEND(ys, [y])) == word_add(wsum(ys), y)

entries.name: asum_addr
entries.statement:
∀ (p n i y : W32) (xs ys zs : List[W32])
if
  1. val(p) + 4 * val(n) < 4294967296
  2. LENGTH(xs) == val(n)
  3. xs == APPEND(ys, CONS(y, zs))
  4. LENGTH(ys) == val(i)
then
  val(word_add(p, word_mul(i, word(4)))) + 0 == val(p) + 4 * LENGTH(ys)

entries.name: asum_step
entries.statement:
∀ (p n i y : W32) (xs ys zs : List[W32])
if
  1. LENGTH(xs) == val(n)
  2. xs == APPEND(ys, CONS(y, zs))
  3. LENGTH(ys) == val(i)
  4. word_ult(word_add(i, word(1)), n)
then
  ∃ (y2 : W32) (zs2 : List[W32]),
    zs == CONS(y2, zs2)
    && LENGTH(APPEND(ys, [y])) == val(word_add(i, word(1)))

entries.name: asum_exit
entries.statement:
∀ (p n i y : W32) (xs ys zs : List[W32])
if
  1. LENGTH(xs) == val(n)
  2. xs == APPEND(ys, CONS(y, zs))
  3. LENGTH(ys) == val(i)
  4. !word_ult(word_add(i, word(1)), n)
then
  word_add(i, word(1)) == n
  && word_add(wsum(ys), y) == wsum(xs)

entries.name: asum_entry
entries.statement:
∀ (n : W32) (xs : List[W32])
if
  1. word_ult(word(0), n)
  2. LENGTH(xs) == val(n)
then
  ∃ (y : W32) (zs : List[W32]), xs == CONS(y, zs)

entries.name: asum_none
entries.statement:
∀ (n : W32) (xs : List[W32])
if
  1. !word_ult(word(0), n)
  2. LENGTH(xs) == val(n)
then
  n == word(0)
  && xs == NIL

entries.name: array_sum_code
entries.statement:
array_sum_code ==
  local.get 2
  local.get 1
  i32.lt_u
  if
    loop
      local.get 3
      local.get 0
      local.get 2
      i32.const 4
      i32.mul
      i32.add
      i32.load offset=0 align=2**2
      i32.add
      local.set 3
      local.get 2
      i32.const 1
      i32.add
      local.set 2
      local.get 2
      local.get 1
      i32.lt_u
      br_if 0
    end
  end

entries.name: example_array_sum
entries.statement:
∀ (vs0 : List[Value]) (n p : W32) (xs : List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. LENGTH(xs) == val(n)
  2. val(p) + 4 * val(n) < 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      vs0,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(n)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => star(arr(val(p), xs), fp(gs, ms))),
    array_sum_code,
    st(
      vs0,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(n)), V_num(ConstInt32(n)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(wsum(xs)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => star(arr(val(p), xs), fp(gs, ms))))

entries.name: sorted
entries.statement:
sorted((xs : List[W32]))
  == PAIRWISE((a : W32) => (b : W32) => val(a) <= val(b), xs)

entries.name: perm
entries.statement:
perm((xs : List[W32]), (ys : List[W32])) == (
  ∀ y : W32,
    LENGTH(FILTER((z : W32) => z == y, xs))
      == LENGTH(FILTER((z : W32) => z == y, ys)))

entries.name: perm_refl
entries.statement: ∀ (xs : List[W32]), perm(xs, xs)

entries.name: perm_swap
entries.statement:
∀ (A ts ys : List[W32]) (e x : W32)
if
  1. perm(APPEND(A, CONS(e, CONS(x, ts))), ys)
then
  perm(APPEND(A, CONS(x, CONS(e, ts))), ys)

entries.name: sorted_insert
entries.statement:
∀ (L G : List[W32]) (x : W32)
if
  1. sorted(APPEND(L, G))
  2. ALL((y : W32) => val(y) <= val(x), L)
  3. ALL((g : W32) => val(x) < val(g), G)
then
  sorted(APPEND(L, CONS(x, G)))

entries.name: sorted_snoc_le
entries.statement:
∀ (L G : List[W32]) (e x : W32)
if
  1. sorted(APPEND(L, CONS(e, G)))
  2. val(e) <= val(x)
then
  ALL((y : W32) => val(y) <= val(x), APPEND(L, [e]))

entries.name: list_update_snoc
entries.statement:
∀ (l2 r : List[A]) (e d x : A),
  list_update(APPEND(l2, CONS(e, CONS(d, r))), SUC(LENGTH(l2)), x)
    == APPEND(l2, CONS(e, CONS(x, r)))

entries.name: isort_bound
entries.statement:
∀ (L G : List[W32]) (j i n : W32)
if
  1. LENGTH(L) == val(j)
  2. LENGTH(APPEND(L, G)) == val(i)
  3. val(i) < val(n)
then
  val(j) < val(n)
  && !(j == word(0)) → val(word_sub(j, word(1))) < val(n)

entries.name: isort_inner_entry
entries.statement:
∀ (ss rs : List[W32]) (i n : W32)
if
  1. LENGTH(ss) == val(i)
  2. val(i) < val(n)
  3. LENGTH(APPEND(ss, rs)) == val(n)
then
  ∃ (r : W32) (t : List[W32]),
    rs == CONS(r, t)
    && EL(val(i), APPEND(ss, CONS(r, t))) == r

entries.name: isort_empty
entries.statement:
∀ (L : List[W32]) (j x : W32)
if
  1. LENGTH(L) == val(j)
  2. j == word(0)
then
  ALL((y : W32) => val(y) <= val(x), L)

entries.name: isort_stop
entries.statement:
∀ (L G M : List[W32]) (d x j : W32)
if
  1. LENGTH(L) == val(j)
  2. !(j == word(0))
  3. sorted(APPEND(L, G))
  4. word_ule(EL(val(word_sub(j, word(1))), APPEND(L, CONS(d, M))), x)
then
  ALL((y : W32) => val(y) <= val(x), L)

entries.name: isort_shift
entries.statement:
∀ (L G rest xs : List[W32]) (d j x i n : W32)
if
  1. !(j == word(0))
  2. !word_ule(
       EL(val(word_sub(j, word(1))), APPEND(L, CONS(d, APPEND(G, rest)))),
       x)
  3. LENGTH(L) == val(j)
  4. sorted(APPEND(L, G))
  5. ALL((g : W32) => val(x) < val(g), G)
  6. LENGTH(APPEND(L, G)) == val(i)
  7. val(i) < val(n)
  8. LENGTH(APPEND(L, CONS(d, APPEND(G, rest)))) == val(n)

          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 3
          i32.const 1

          local.set 3

      local.get 0
      local.get 3

      i32.mul

      local.get 4

      local.get 2

  3. perm(APPEND(L, G), Bt)

entries.name: quicksort_code

  local.get 0
  local.get 1
  local.get 3
  call 0
  local.get 0
  local.get 3
  i32.const 1

  local.get 2
  call 0

∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (inst : Inst) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (j : Num)
  (p n : W32) (xs : List[W32]) (before after : List[Byte]) (vs0 : List[Value])
  (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, 0), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32)],
       quicksort_code)
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, 1), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       partition_code)
  3. s_funcs(s) == fs
  4. f_inst(f) == inst
  5. smem_ind(inst) == SOME(j)
  6. j < LENGTH(s_mems(s))
  7. globs_ok(s, f)
  8. LENGTH(xs) == val(n)
  9. val(p) + 4 * val(n) < 4294967296
  10. SND(EL(j, s_mems(s))) == APPEND(before, APPEND(words_bytes(xs), after))
  11. LENGTH(before) == val(p)
  12. reduce_trans(
        (
          s,
          f,
          APPEND(
            MAP(
              v_to_e,
              APPEND(
                vs0,
                [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))),
                 V_num(ConstInt32(n))])),
            [Basic(Call(0))])),
        (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (ys : List[W32]),
    sorted(ys)
    && perm(ys, xs)
    && es2 == MAP(v_to_e, vs0)
    && s_funcs(s2) == fs
    && s_tabs(s2) == s_tabs(s)
    && f_inst(f2) == inst
    && f_locs(f2) == f_locs(f)
    && gvals(s2, f2) == gvals(s, f)
    && SND(EL(j, s_mems(s2))) == APPEND(before, APPEND(words_bytes(ys), after))
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: apply_closed
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (inst : Inst) (a j : Num) (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe)
  (x k : W32) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. 0 < LENGTH(inst_tabs(inst))
  2. tab_cl_ind(s_tabs(s), EL(0, inst_tabs(inst)), val(k))
       == SOME(ConstRefFunc(a))
  3. cl_type(EL(a, fs)) == stypes(inst, 0)
  4. EL(a, fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       NIL,
       double_code)
  5. s_funcs(s) == fs
  6. f_inst(f) == inst
  7. f_locs(f) == [V_num(ConstInt32(x)), V_num(ConstInt32(k))]
  8. smem_ind(inst) == SOME(j)
  9. j < LENGTH(s_mems(s))
  10. globs_ok(s, f)
  11. reduce_trans((s, f, MAP(Basic, apply_code)), (s2, f2, es2))
then
  es2 == MAP(v_to_e, [V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(x, x)))])
  && s_funcs(s2) == fs
  && s_tabs(s2) == s_tabs(s)
  && f_inst(f2) == inst
  && f_locs(f2) == f_locs(f)
  && gvals(s2, f2) == gvals(s, f)
  && heap_of(EL(j, s_mems(s2))) == heap_of(EL(j, s_mems(s)))
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: tlsf_fli
entries.statement: tlsf_fli((s : W32)) == word_sub(word(31), int_clz(s))

entries.name: tlsf_sli
entries.statement:
tlsf_sli((s : W32), (f : W32))
  == word_and(word_jushr(s, word_sub(f, word(4))), word(15))

entries.name: tlsf_mask
entries.statement:
tlsf_mask((s : W32))
  == word_sub(word_jshl(word(1), word_sub(tlsf_fli(s), word(4))), word(1))

entries.name: tlsf_round
entries.statement:
tlsf_round((s : W32))
  == word_and(word_add(s, tlsf_mask(s)), word_not(tlsf_mask(s)))

entries.name: tlsf_exp_lt
entries.statement: ∀ (m n : Num), (EXP(2, m) < EXP(2, n)) == (m < n)

entries.name: tlsf_fli_clz
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. !(s == word(0))
then
  val(tlsf_fli(s)) == 31 - word_clz(s)

entries.name: tlsf_fli_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. !(s == word(0))
then
  val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s))) <= val(s)
  && val(s) < EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) + 1)

entries.name: tlsf_fli_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32) (f : Num)
if
  1. EXP(2, f) <= val(s)
  2. val(s) < EXP(2, f + 1)
then
  val(tlsf_fli(s)) == f

entries.name: tlsf_sli_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  4 <= val(tlsf_fli(s))
  && val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))
       == MOD(DIV(val(s), EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)), 16)

entries.name: tlsf_class_num
entries.statement:
∀ (v k : Num)
if
  1. EXP(2, k + 4) <= v
  2. v < EXP(2, k + 5)
then
  16 <= DIV(v, EXP(2, k))
  && DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) < 32
  && MOD(DIV(v, EXP(2, k)), 16) == DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) - 16
  && DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) * EXP(2, k) <= v
  && v < DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) * EXP(2, k) + EXP(2, k)

entries.name: tlsf_class
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  4 <= val(tlsf_fli(s))
  && val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s))) < 16
  && (16 + val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))) * EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) <= val(
       s)
  && val(s) < (17 + val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))) * EXP(
       2,
       val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)

entries.name: tlsf_mask_word
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  tlsf_mask(s) == word(EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) - 1)

entries.name: tlsf_round_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
then
  val(tlsf_round(s)) == EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) * DIV(
    val(s) + (EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) - 1),
    EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4))

entries.name: tlsf_class_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
  2. MOD(val(x), EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(x)) - 4)) == 0
then
  (16 + val(tlsf_sli(x, tlsf_fli(x)))) * EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(x)) - 4) == val(x)

entries.name: tlsf_round_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
then
  val(s) <= val(tlsf_round(s))
  && val(tlsf_round(s)) < val(s) + EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)
  && (16 + val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_round(s), tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))))) * EXP(
       2,
       val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))) - 4)
       == val(tlsf_round(s))

entries.name: tlsf_find_sound
entries.statement:
∀ (s t : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
  3. 16 <= val(t)
  4. val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))) < val(tlsf_fli(t))
     || val(tlsf_fli(t)) == val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s)))
        && val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_round(s), tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s)))) <= val(
             tlsf_sli(t, tlsf_fli(t)))
then
  val(s) <= val(t)

entries.name: tlsf_class_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (x y : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
  2. val(x) <= val(y)
then
  val(tlsf_fli(x)) < val(tlsf_fli(y))
or
  val(tlsf_fli(y)) == val(tlsf_fli(x))
  && val(tlsf_sli(x, tlsf_fli(x))) <= val(tlsf_sli(y, tlsf_fli(y)))

tlsf_code_fli

  word_and(word_jushr(x, word_sub(word(27), word(word_clz(x)))), word(15))

entries.name: star_pure_hr

∀ (c : Bool) (p q : HProp),

entries.name: star_pure_hl

∀ (c : Bool) (p q : HProp),

entries.name: star_ex_hr
entries.statement:
∀ (p : HProp) (qq : (A, Heap) -> Bool),
  star(p, (h : Heap) => ∃ x : A, qq(x, h))
    == ((h : Heap) => ∃ x : A, star(p, qq(x), h))

entries.name: star_ex_hl

entries.name: star_emp_hr

entries.name: star_emp_hl
entries.statement: ∀ (p : HProp), star(emp, p) == p

entries.name: sl_pure

∀ (c : Bool) (p q : SAssn) (bs : List[B_e])

  1. c → sl_triple(p, bs, q)
then

    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      c && p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h),

    q)

  (bs : List[B_e]) (q : SAssn)

    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ x : A, pp(x, vs, lc, gs, ms, h),

    q)

entries.name: tlsf_sync
entries.statement:
tlsf_sync((s : W32), (n : Num), (ne : (Num) -> Bool))
  == (∀ k : Num, bit(k, s) == (k < n && ne(k)))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_set
entries.statement:
∀ (s j : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. val(j) < n
  2. n <= 32
  3. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
then
  tlsf_sync(
    word_or(s, word_jshl(word(1), j)),
    n,
    (k : Num) => k == val(j) || ne(k))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_clear
entries.statement:
∀ (s j : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. val(j) < n
  2. n <= 32
  3. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
  4. ne(val(j))
then
  tlsf_sync(
    word_xor(s, word_jshl(word(1), j)),
    n,
    (k : Num) => !(k == val(j)) && ne(k))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_zero
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
then
  (s == word(0)) == (∀ k : Num, k < n → !ne(k))

entries.name: tlsf_code_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
then
  val(word_and(word_jushr(x, word_sub(word(27), word(word_clz(x)))), word(15))) < 16
  && (val : (W32) -> Num)(
       (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
         (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
         (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(x)))) < 28
